In the single-intervention regime, we show that the optimal strategy is to recommend the action that maximizes the human value function. For settings with multiple interventions, we propose a tractable approximation that prioritizes interventions based on the magnitude of the policy-value discrepancy. We evaluate these ideas in the domain of chess by learning models of humans from large-scale gameplay data. In simulation, our approach consistently outperforms interventions based on the strongest chess engine (Stockfish) in a wide range of settings. A within-subject human study with 20 players and 600 games further shows that our interventions significantly improve performance for low- and mid-skill players while matching expert-engine interventions for high-skill players.

AI.tldr: 提出价值感知干预方法，通过检测策略-价值不一致性来识别AI干预时机，在象棋实验中优于基于最强引擎的干预策略
AI.motivation: AI系统在顺序决策任务中辅助人类时，确定何时以及如何干预是根本挑战。基于最优模型的推荐假设人类会执行最优后续动作，但人类决策者可能无法执行，反而降低整体性能。
AI.method: 提出价值感知干预方法，基于强化学习中的贝尔曼方程原理：当决策者遵循次优策略时，策略-价值一致性不再成立，这种不一致性自然识别了干预机会。在马尔可夫决策过程中形式化该问题，AI助手可在干预预算内覆盖人类动作。在单次干预机制中，最优策略是推荐最大化人类价值函数的动作；对于多次干预设置，提出基于策略-价值差异幅度的可处理近似方法。
AI.result: 在象棋领域通过大规模游戏数据学习人类模型进行评估。模拟实验中，该方法在各种设置下始终优于基于最强象棋引擎（Stockfish）的干预策略。对20名玩家和600场游戏的人体实验进一步表明，该方法显著提高了低技能和中技能玩家的表现，同时在高技能玩家中与专家引擎干预效果相当。
AI.conclusion: 价值感知干预通过检测策略-价值不一致性有效识别AI干预时机，在人类辅助决策任务中优于传统的最优模型推荐方法，特别适用于人类决策者可能无法执行最优后续动作的场景。

title: Response-Aware User Memory Selection for LLM Personalization
summary: A common approach to personalization in large language models (LLMs) is to incorporate a subset of the user memory into the prompt at inference time to guide the model's generation. Existing methods select these subsets primarily using similarity between user memory items and input queries, ignoring how features actually affect the model's response distribution. We propose Response-Utility optimization for Memory Selection (RUMS), a novel method that selects user memory items by measuring the mutual information between a subset of memory and the model's outputs, identifying items that reduce response uncertainty and sharpen predictions beyond semantic similarity. We demonstrate that this information-theoretic foundation enables more principled user memory selection that aligns more closely with human selection compared to state-of-the-art methods, and models $400\times$ larger. Additionally, we show that memory items selected using RUMS result in better response quality compared to existing approaches, while having up to $95\%$ reduction in computational cost.

AI.tldr: RUMS是一种基于互信息优化的记忆选择方法，通过测量记忆子集与模型输出之间的互信息来选择用户记忆项，相比基于语义相似性的方法能更有效地减少响应不确定性并提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语言模型个性化方法主要基于用户记忆项与输入查询之间的语义相似性来选择记忆子集，忽略了这些特征如何实际影响模型的响应分布，导致记忆选择不够有效。
AI.method: 提出响应效用优化的记忆选择方法（RUMS），通过测量记忆子集与模型输出之间的互信息来选择用户记忆项，识别那些能减少响应不确定性并锐化预测的记忆项，超越了单纯的语义相似性匹配。
AI.result: RUMS相比现有方法能更接近人类选择记忆的方式，且优于比其大400倍的模型；使用RUMS选择的记忆项能带来更好的响应质量，同时计算成本降低高达95%。
AI.conclusion: 基于信息论基础的RUMS方法为记忆选择提供了更原则性的框架，能够更有效地利用用户记忆来提升语言模型的个性化响应质量，同时显著降低计算开销。

title: ReviewGrounder: Improving Review Substantiveness with Rubric-Guided, Tool-Integrated Agents
summary: The rapid rise in AI conference submissions has driven increasing exploration of large language models (LLMs) for peer review support. However, LLM-based reviewers often generate superficial, formulaic comments lacking substantive, evidence-grounded feedback. We attribute this to the underutilization of two key components of human reviewing: explicit rubrics and contextual grounding in existing work. To address this, we introduce REVIEWBENCH, a benchmark evaluating review text according to paper-specific rubrics derived from official guidelines, the paper's content, and human-written reviews. We further propose REVIEWGROUNDER, a rubric-guided, tool-integrated multi-agent framework that decomposes reviewing into drafting and grounding stages, enriching shallow drafts via targeted evidence consolidation. Experiments on REVIEWBENCH show that REVIEWGROUNDER, using a Phi-4-14B-based drafter and a GPT-OSS-120B-based grounding stage, consistently outperforms baselines with substantially stronger/larger backbones (e.g., GPT-4.1 and DeepSeek-R1-670B) in both alignment with human judgments and rubric-based review quality across 8 dimensions. The code is available \href{https://github.com/EigenTom/ReviewGrounder}{here}.

AI.tldr: 提出了REVIEWBENCH基准和REVIEWGROUNDER框架，通过基于论文特定评分标准和上下文证据的多阶段评审流程，显著提升了LLM生成评审意见的质量。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM生成的同行评审意见往往流于表面、公式化，缺乏实质性和基于证据的反馈。这主要是因为未能充分利用人类评审的两个关键要素：明确的评分标准和基于现有工作的上下文基础。
AI.method: 1. 引入REVIEWBENCH基准，根据官方指南、论文内容和人工评审意见制定论文特定评分标准来评估评审文本质量。2. 提出REVIEWGROUNDER框架，采用评分标准引导、工具集成的多智能体系统，将评审过程分解为起草和证据夯实两个阶段，通过有针对性的证据整合来丰富浅层草稿。
AI.result: 实验表明，使用Phi-4-14B起草器和GPT-OSS-120B证据夯实阶段的REVIEWGROUNDER，在8个维度的评分标准对齐度和评审质量方面，始终优于使用更强大/更大骨干模型（如GPT-4.1和DeepSeek-R1-670B）的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合明确的评分标准和上下文证据夯实，REVIEWGROUNDER框架能够生成更高质量、更具实质性的LLM评审意见，为解决当前LLM评审的局限性提供了有效方案。

title: EuropeMedQA Study Protocol: A Multilingual, Multimodal Medical Examination Dataset for Language Model Evaluation
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated high proficiency on English-centric medical examinations, their performance often declines when faced with non-English languages and multimodal diagnostic tasks. This study protocol describes the development of EuropeMedQA, the first comprehensive, multilingual, and multimodal medical examination dataset sourced from official regulatory exams in Italy, France, Spain, and Portugal. Following FAIR data principles and SPIRIT-AI guidelines, we describe a rigorous curation process and an automated translation pipeline for comparative analysis. We evaluate contemporary multimodal LLMs using a zero-shot, strictly constrained prompting strategy to assess cross-lingual transfer and visual reasoning. EuropeMedQA aims to provide a contamination-resistant benchmark that reflects the complexity of European clinical practices and fosters the development of more generalizable medical AI.

AI.tldr: 开发EuropeMedQA——首个基于意大利、法国、西班牙和葡萄牙官方监管考试的多语言多模态医学考试数据集，用于评估LLM在非英语医学诊断任务中的表现
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在英语医学考试中表现出色，但在非英语语言和多模态诊断任务中性能下降，需要开发能反映欧洲临床实践复杂性的基准数据集
AI.method: 遵循FAIR数据原则和SPIRIT-AI指南，建立严格的数据筛选流程和自动翻译管道，使用零样本、严格约束的提示策略评估当代多模态LLM的跨语言迁移和视觉推理能力
AI.result: 创建了EuropeMedQA数据集，这是一个抗污染基准，旨在促进更具普适性的医学AI发展，但具体评估结果未在摘要中提供
AI.conclusion: EuropeMedQA为评估LLM在欧洲多语言多模态医学环境中的表现提供了首个综合性基准，有助于推动更具普适性的医学人工智能发展

title: Pushing the Limits of On-Device Streaming ASR: A Compact, High-Accuracy English Model for Low-Latency Inference
summary: Deploying high-quality automatic speech recognition (ASR) on edge devices requires models that jointly optimize accuracy, latency, and memory footprint while operating entirely on CPU without GPU acceleration. We conduct a systematic empirical study of state-of-the-art ASR architectures, encompassing encoder-decoder, transducer, and LLM-based paradigms, evaluated across batch, chunked, and streaming inference modes. Through a comprehensive benchmark of over 50 configurations spanning OpenAI Whisper, NVIDIA Nemotron, Parakeet TDT, Canary, Conformer Transducer, and Qwen3-ASR, we identify NVIDIA's Nemotron Speech Streaming as the strongest candidate for real-time English streaming on resource-constrained hardware. We then re-implement the complete streaming inference pipeline in ONNX Runtime and conduct a controlled evaluation of multiple post-training quantization strategies, including importance-weighted k-quant, mixed-precision schemes, and round-to-nearest quantization, combined with graph-level operator fusion. These optimizations reduce the model from 2.47 GB to as little as 0.67 GB while maintaining word error rate (WER) within 1% absolute of the full-precision PyTorch baseline. Our recommended configuration, the int4 k-quant variant, achieves 8.20% average streaming WER across eight standard benchmarks, running comfortably faster than real-time on CPU with 0.56 s algorithmic latency, establishing a new quality-efficiency Pareto point for on-device streaming ASR.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了多种ASR架构在边缘设备上的性能，发现NVIDIA Nemotron Speech Streaming最适合实时英语流式识别，并通过量化优化将模型从2.47GB压缩至0.67GB，同时保持WER在基线1%以内。
AI.motivation: 在边缘设备上部署高质量ASR需要模型在CPU上同时优化准确性、延迟和内存占用，而无需GPU加速。现有研究缺乏对多种ASR架构在资源受限硬件上的系统性评估和优化方案。
AI.method: 1. 系统评估了超过50种ASR配置，涵盖编码器-解码器、转换器和基于LLM的范式，包括OpenAI Whisper、NVIDIA Nemotron、Parakeet TDT等模型；2. 在ONNX Runtime中重新实现完整的流式推理管道；3. 评估多种后训练量化策略，包括重要性加权k-quant、混合精度方案和最近邻舍入量化，结合图级算子融合。
AI.result: 1. NVIDIA Nemotron Speech Streaming被确定为资源受限硬件上实时英语流式识别的最佳候选；2. 量化优化将模型从2.47GB压缩至0.67GB，同时保持WER在完整精度PyTorch基线的1%绝对误差内；3. 推荐的int4 k-quant变体在八个标准基准测试中平均流式WER为8.20%，算法延迟0.56秒，CPU上运行速度快于实时。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过系统性评估和量化优化，为边缘设备上的流式ASR建立了一个新的质量-效率帕累托点，证明了在资源受限的CPU硬件上部署高质量实时ASR的可行性。

title: Tracking the Temporal Dynamics of News Coverage of Catastrophic and Violent Events
summary: The modern news cycle has been fundamentally reshaped by the rapid exchange of information online. As a result, media framing shifts dynamically as new information, political responses, and social reactions emerge. Understanding how these narratives form, propagate, and evolve is essential for interpreting public discourse during moments of crisis. In this study, we examine the temporal and semantic dynamics of reporting for violent and catastrophic events using a large-scale corpus of 126,602 news articles collected from online publishers. We quantify narrative change through publication volume, semantic drift, semantic dispersion, and term relevance. Our results show that sudden events of impact exhibit structured and predictable news-cycle patterns characterized by rapid surges in coverage, early semantic drift, and gradual declines toward the baseline. In addition, our results indicate the terms that are driving the temporal patterns.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析126,602篇新闻文章，量化了暴力灾难事件报道的叙事动态，发现突发事件的新闻周期具有可预测模式：报道量激增、早期语义漂移、逐渐回归基线。
AI.motivation: 现代新闻周期因在线信息快速交换而重塑，媒体报道框架随新信息、政治反应和社会反应动态变化。理解这些叙事如何形成、传播和演变对于解读危机时期的公共话语至关重要。
AI.method: 使用从在线出版商收集的126,602篇新闻文章构建大规模语料库，通过出版量、语义漂移、语义分散和术语相关性四个指标量化叙事变化。
AI.result: 突发影响事件展现出结构化且可预测的新闻周期模式：报道量快速激增、早期语义漂移、逐渐向基线水平下降。研究还识别出驱动这些时间模式的特定术语。
AI.conclusion: 暴力灾难事件的媒体报道遵循可量化的动态模式，这些模式有助于理解公共话语的形成和演变，为危机时期的叙事分析提供了实证框架。

title: Improving Machine Learning Performance with Synthetic Augmentation
summary:
Synthetic augmentation is increasingly used to mitigate data scarcity in financial machine learning, yet its statistical role remains poorly understood. We formalize synthetic augmentation as a modification of the effective training distribution and show that it induces a structural bias--variance trade-off: while additional samples may reduce estimation error, they may also shift the population objective whenever the synthetic distribution deviates from regions relevant under evaluation. To isolate informational gains from mechanical sample-size effects, we introduce a size-matched null augmentation and a finite-sample, non-parametric block permutation test that remains valid under weak temporal dependence.
  We evaluate this framework in both controlled Markov-switching environments and real financial datasets, including high-frequency option trade data and a daily equity panel. Across generators spanning bootstrap, copula-based models, variational autoencoders, diffusion models, and TimeGAN, we vary augmentation ratio, model capacity, task type, regime rarity, and signal-to-noise. We show that synthetic augmentation is beneficial only in variance-dominant regimes, such as persistent volatility forecasting-while it deteriorates performance in bias-dominant settings, including near-efficient directional prediction. Rare-regime targeting can improve domain-specific metrics but may conflict with unconditional permutation inference. Our results provide a structural perspective on when synthetic data improves financial learning performance and when it induces persistent distributional distortion.

AI.tldr: 该论文形式化分析了金融机器学习中合成数据增强的统计效应，揭示了其引发的结构偏差-方差权衡，并开发了分离信息增益与样本量效应的检验方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管合成数据增强在金融机器学习中广泛用于缓解数据稀缺问题，但其统计作用机制尚未被充分理解。研究者需要明确合成数据增强何时真正提升学习性能，何时仅引入分布失真。
AI.method: 1. 将合成数据增强形式化为训练分布的有效修改；2. 引入大小匹配的零增强作为对照，分离信息增益与机械样本量效应；3. 开发有限样本、非参数块置换检验，适用于弱时间依赖场景；4. 在受控马尔可夫切换环境和真实金融数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 合成数据增强仅在方差主导的机制中（如持续性波动率预测）有益，而在偏差主导的设置中（如接近有效的方向预测）会损害性能。针对罕见机制的增强可改善特定领域指标，但可能与无条件置换推断相冲突。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据增强在金融学习中的效果取决于偏差-方差权衡：它主要缓解方差问题而非偏差问题。研究提供了结构化的视角，帮助判断何时合成数据能真正提升性能，何时会引入持久的分布失真。

title: LLM Predictive Scoring and Validation: Inferring Experience Ratings from Unstructured Text
summary: We tasked GPT-4.1 to read what baseball fans wrote about their game-day experience and predict the overall experience rating each fan gave on a 0-10 survey scale. The model received only the text of a single open-ended response. These AI predictions were compared with the actual experience ratings captured by the survey instrument across approximately 10,000 fan responses from five Major League Baseball teams. In total two-thirds of predicted ratings fell within one point of self-reported fan ratings (67% within +/-1, 36% exact match), and the predicted measurement was near-deterministic across three independent scoring runs (87% exact agreement, 99.9% within +/-1). Predicted ratings aligned most strongly with the overall experience rating (r = 0.82) rather than with any specific aspect of the game-day experience such as parking, concessions, staff, etc. However, predictions were systematically lower than self-reported ratings by approximately one point, and this gap was not driven by any single aspect. Rather, our analysis shows that self-reported ratings capture the fan's verdict, an overall evaluative judgment that integrates the entire experience. While predicted ratings quantify the impact of salient moments characterized as memorable, emotionally intense, unusual, or actionable. Each measure contains information the other misses. These baseline results establish that a simple, unoptimized prompt can directionally predict how fans rate their experience from the text a fan wrote and that a gap between the two numbers can be interpreted as a construct difference worth preserving rather than an error to eliminate.

AI.tldr: GPT-4.1通过分析棒球迷的开放式文本反馈预测其整体体验评分（0-10分），预测结果与实际调查评分在约10,000份响应中达到67%的±1分内准确率，但存在系统性低估约1分的差异。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探索大型语言模型能否从球迷的开放式文本反馈中准确预测其整体体验评分，并比较AI预测与自我报告评分之间的差异及其潜在原因。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4.1模型分析来自5支美国职业棒球大联盟球队约10,000份球迷的开放式文本反馈，预测其0-10分的整体体验评分。将AI预测结果与实际调查评分进行比较，评估预测准确性（精确匹配、±1分内匹配），并分析预测评分与各项具体体验维度（停车、餐饮、员工等）的相关性。
AI.result: 预测评分与实际评分高度相关（r=0.82），67%的预测落在实际评分±1分范围内，36%为精确匹配。预测具有高度一致性（三次独立评分运行中87%精确一致，99.9%在±1分内）。但预测评分系统性低估约1分，且这种差异不受任何单一体验维度驱动。
AI.conclusion: 简单的未优化提示即可从文本中方向性预测球迷体验评分。预测评分与自我报告评分之间的差异反映了两种测量方式捕捉不同构念：自我报告评分反映整体评价判断，而预测评分量化了突出时刻（难忘、情感强烈、不寻常或可行动）的影响。这种差异值得保留而非消除。

title: Geometric Metrics for MoE Specialization: From Fisher Information to Early Failure Detection
summary: Expert specialization is fundamental to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model success, yet existing metrics (cosine similarity, routing entropy) lack theoretical grounding and yield inconsistent conclusions under reparameterization. We present an information-geometric framework providing the first rigorous characterization of MoE specialization dynamics. Our key insight is that expert routing distributions evolve on the probability simplex equipped with the Fisher information metric, enabling formal analysis via Riemannian geometry. We prove that standard heuristic metrics violate parameterization invariance (Theorem 1), establish that specialization corresponds to geodesic flow with quantified approximation bounds (Theorem 2), and derive a failure predictor with theoretical threshold justification (Theorem 3). The framework introduces two principled metrics: Fisher Specialization Index (FSI) achieving r=0.91+/-0.02 correlation with downstream performance, and Fisher Heterogeneity Score (FHS) predicting training failure at 10% completion with AUC=0.89+/-0.03 -- outperforming validation-loss-based early stopping by 23% while requiring 40x fewer compute cycles. We validate intervention protocols achieving 87% recovery rate when FHS>1 is detected. Comprehensive experiments across language modeling (WikiText-103, C4), vision MoE (ImageNet), and scaling studies (8-64 experts, 125M-2.7B parameters) validate our theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个信息几何框架，首次为MoE模型中的专家专业化提供了严格的理论基础，解决了现有指标缺乏理论依据和参数化不变性的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有衡量MoE专家专业化的指标（如余弦相似度、路由熵）缺乏理论依据，在不同参数化下会得出不一致的结论，需要建立严谨的理论框架来准确表征MoE的专业化动态。
AI.method: 采用信息几何框架，将专家路由分布视为概率单纯形上的演化过程，使用Fisher信息度量进行黎曼几何分析。提出了两个原则性指标：Fisher专业化指数（FSI）和Fisher异质性分数（FHS），并建立了三个核心定理。
AI.result: FSI与下游性能相关性达r=0.91±0.02；FHS在训练完成10%时预测失败AUC=0.89±0.03，比基于验证损失的早停方法提升23%且减少40倍计算周期；当FHS>1时干预协议恢复率达87%。
AI.conclusion: 该信息几何框架为MoE专业化提供了首个严格的理论基础，提出的指标在语言建模、视觉MoE和扩展研究中均验证有效，显著提升了MoE模型的训练效率和可靠性。

title: Perspective on Bias in Biomedical AI: Preventing Downstream Healthcare Disparities
summary: Healthcare disparities persist across socioeconomic boundaries, often attributed to unequal access to screening, diagnostics, and therapeutics. However, this perspective highlights that critical biases can emerge much earlier, during data collection and research prioritization, long before clinical implementation in cases where the focus of the studies and the data that is collected is at the molecular level. A vast number of studies focus on collecting omics data but the demographic information associated with these datasets is often not reported in the studies, and when it is reported, it shows big biases. An automated analysis of 4719 PubMed-indexed omics publications from 2015 to 2024 reveals that only a small fraction report ancestry or ethnicity information, with ancestry reporting improving slightly. Analysis of large-scale datasets commonly used for model training, such as CellxGene and GEO, reveals substantial population bias where European-ancestry data dominates. As biomedical foundation models become central to biomedical discovery with a paradigm in which base models are pretrained on large datasets and reusing them time and again for many different downstream tasks, they risk perpetuating or amplifying these early-stage biases, leading to cascading inequities that regulatory interventions cannot fully reverse. We propose a community-wide focus on three foundational principles: Provenance, Openness, and Evaluation Transparency to improve equity and robustness in biomedical AI. This approach aims to foster biomedical innovation that more effectively serves underserved populations and improves health outcomes.

AI.tldr: 论文分析了生物医学研究中早期数据收集阶段的偏见问题，特别是组学数据中人口统计学信息缺失和欧洲血统数据主导的现象，警告这会在生物医学基础模型中放大健康不平等，并提出三个改进原则。
AI.motivation: 本文的动机是揭示健康不平等不仅源于临床实施阶段的差异，更源于研究早期数据收集和优先级的偏见。当前大量组学研究收集数据时缺乏人口统计学信息报告，即使报告也显示严重偏见，这种早期偏见会在生物医学基础模型中固化并放大，导致监管干预难以逆转的级联不平等。
AI.method: 采用自动化分析方法，对2015-2024年间4719篇PubMed索引的组学出版物进行分析，评估其祖先或种族信息报告情况。同时分析常用模型训练数据集（如CellxGene和GEO）的人口分布偏见，特别关注欧洲血统数据的主导地位。
AI.result: 分析显示只有一小部分组学出版物报告祖先或种族信息，虽然祖先报告略有改善。大规模数据集分析揭示显著的人口偏见，欧洲血统数据占据主导地位。这种早期数据偏见会在生物医学基础模型中被放大，这些模型在大数据集上预训练后重复用于多种下游任务，可能导致监管无法完全逆转的级联不平等。
AI.conclusion: 为解决这一问题，作者提出社区应关注三个基础原则：来源（Provenance）、开放性（Openness）和评估透明度（Evaluation Transparency），以提高生物医学AI的公平性和鲁棒性，促进更好地服务未充分服务人群并改善健康结果的生物医学创新。

title: Faithfulness Serum: Mitigating the Faithfulness Gap in Textual Explanations of LLM Decisions via Attribution Guidance
comment: 24 pages, multiple figures (e.g., at least 6 main figures), includes experiments across several benchmarks (MMLU, CommonsenseQA, SciQ, ARC, OpenBookQA); code available on GitHub
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance and have revolutionized NLP, but their lack of explainability keeps them treated as black boxes, limiting their use in domains that demand transparency and trust. A promising direction to address this issue is post-hoc text-based explanations, which aim to explain model decisions in natural language. Prior work has focused on generating convincing rationales that appear to be subjectively faithful, but it remains unclear whether these explanations are epistemically faithful, whether they reflect the internal evidence the model actually relied on for its decision. In this paper, we first assess the epistemic faithfulness of LLM-generated explanations via counterfactuals and show that they are often unfaithful. We then introduce a training-free method that enhances faithfulness by guiding explanation generation through attention-level interventions, informed by token-level heatmaps extracted via a faithful attribution method. This method significantly improves epistemic faithfulness across multiple models, benchmarks, and prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM生成解释的认知忠实性问题，提出通过注意力干预提升解释忠实性的无训练方法
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然性能强大但缺乏可解释性，限制了其在需要透明度和信任的领域应用。现有的事后文本解释方法主要关注生成主观上可信的推理，但这些解释是否认知忠实（反映模型实际依赖的内部证据）尚不明确。
AI.method: 首先通过反事实方法评估LLM生成解释的认知忠实性，发现其往往不忠实。然后提出无训练方法，通过基于忠实归因方法提取的token级热图进行注意力级干预，指导解释生成过程。
AI.result: 该方法在多个模型、基准和提示下显著提升了认知忠实性，证明了注意力干预对增强解释忠实性的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的事后文本解释往往缺乏认知忠实性，但通过注意力级干预可以显著改善这一状况，为开发更可信的模型解释方法提供了有效途径。

title: Mind DeepResearch Technical Report
summary: We present \textbf{Mind DeepResearch (MindDR)}, an efficient multi-agent deep research framework that achieves leading performance with only \textasciitilde30B-parameter models through a meticulously designed data synthesis and multi-stage training pipeline. The core innovation of MindDR lies in a collaborative three-agent architecture (Planning Agent, DeepSearch Agent, and Report Agent) and a four-stage agent-specialized training pipeline comprising SFT cold-start, Search-RL, Report-RL and preference alignment. With this regime, MindDR demonstrates competitive performance even with \textasciitilde30B-scale models. Specifically, MindDR achieves 45.7\% on BrowseComp-ZH, 42.8\% on BrowseComp, 46.5\% on WideSearch, 75.0\% on xbench-DS, and 52.5 on DeepResearch Bench, outperforming comparable-scale open-source agent systems and rivaling larger-scale models. MindDR has been deployed as an online product in Li Auto. Furthermore, we introduce \textbf{MindDR Bench}, a curated benchmark of 500 real-world Chinese queries from our internal product user interactions, evaluated through a comprehensive multi-dimensional rubric system rather than relying on a single RACE metric. On MindDR Bench, MindDR achieves a state-of-the-art score of 51.8.

AI.tldr: MindDR是一个高效的多智能体深度研究框架，通过精心设计的数据合成和多阶段训练流程，仅使用约300亿参数模型就能实现领先性能。该框架采用三智能体协作架构和四阶段专业化训练，在多个基准测试中表现出色，并已部署为在线产品。
AI.motivation: 开发一个高效的深度研究框架，能够在相对较小的模型规模（约300亿参数）下实现与更大规模模型相竞争的性能，同时解决实际产品部署中的真实需求。
AI.method: 1. 三智能体协作架构：规划智能体、深度搜索智能体和报告智能体；2. 四阶段专业化训练流程：SFT冷启动、搜索强化学习、报告强化学习和偏好对齐；3. 精心设计的数据合成方法；4. 引入MindDR Bench基准测试，包含500个真实中文查询和多维度评估体系。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中取得优异表现：BrowseComp-ZH 45.7%、BrowseComp 42.8%、WideSearch 46.5%、xbench-DS 75.0%、DeepResearch Bench 52.5分。在MindDR Bench上达到最先进的51.8分。性能超越同规模开源系统，可与更大规模模型竞争，并已成功部署在理想汽车产品中。
AI.conclusion: MindDR通过创新的多智能体架构和专业化训练流程，证明了相对较小的模型规模也能实现高质量的深度研究能力。该框架不仅在各种基准测试中表现出色，还成功转化为实际产品应用，为高效智能体系统的发展提供了有价值的参考。

title: Shuffle the Context: RoPE-Perturbed Self-Distillation for Long-Context Adaptation
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate in settings that require reliable long-context understanding, such as retrieval-augmented generation and multi-document reasoning. A common strategy is to fine-tune pretrained short-context models at the target sequence length. However, we find that standard long-context adaptation can remain brittle: model accuracy depends strongly on the absolute placement of relevant evidence, exhibiting high positional variance even when controlling for task format and difficulty.
  We propose RoPE-Perturbed Self-Distillation, a training regularizer that improves positional robustness. The core idea is to form alternative "views" of the same training sequence by perturbing its RoPE indices -- effectively moving parts of the context to different positions -- and to train the model to produce consistent predictions across views via self-distillation. This encourages reliance on semantic signals instead of brittle position dependencies. Experiments on long-context adaptation of Llama-3-8B and Qwen-3-4B demonstrate consistent gains on long-context benchmarks, including up to 12.04% improvement on RULER-64K for Llama-3-8B and 2.71% on RULER-256K for Qwen-3-4B after SFT, alongside improved length extrapolation beyond the training context window.

AI.tldr: 提出RoPE-Perturbed Self-Distillation训练正则化方法，通过扰动RoPE索引形成训练序列的替代"视图"，并通过自蒸馏训练模型在不同视图间产生一致预测，从而提高长上下文模型的位置鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在需要可靠长上下文理解的场景中应用日益广泛，但标准的长上下文适应方法仍然脆弱：模型准确度强烈依赖于相关证据的绝对位置，即使控制任务格式和难度，仍表现出高位置方差。
AI.method: 提出RoPE-Perturbed Self-Distillation训练正则化方法，核心思想是通过扰动训练序列的RoPE索引形成替代"视图"，有效将上下文的不同部分移动到不同位置，然后通过自蒸馏训练模型在不同视图间产生一致预测，从而鼓励模型依赖语义信号而非脆弱的位置依赖。
AI.result: 在Llama-3-8B和Qwen-3-4B的长上下文适应实验中，该方法在长上下文基准测试中表现出一致的提升：Llama-3-8B在RULER-64K上提升达12.04%，Qwen-3-4B在RULER-256K上提升2.71%（SFT后），同时改善了超出训练上下文窗口的长度外推能力。
AI.conclusion: RoPE-Perturbed Self-Distillation是一种有效的训练正则化方法，能够显著提高长上下文模型的位置鲁棒性，减少对绝对位置信息的依赖，增强模型在长上下文任务中的稳定性和泛化能力。

title: Quantifying Cross-Query Contradictions in Multi-Query LLM Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. 9 pages, 6 tables, code and data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/rohitspider/cross_query_benchmark
summary: Large language models frequently produce mutually inconsistent answers when reasoning over multiple related queries. We study case-file logical consistency: maintaining a globally satisfiable belief state across interdependent queries. We introduce a benchmark of 390 multi-query reasoning instances with entailment/contradiction/unknown labels and propose set-level metrics including Case Satisfiability Rate, Contradiction Density and Revision Cost. Our solver-augmented approach extracts commitments, verifies global satisfiability and performs counterexample-guided repair. Across four reasoning domains, our method substantially reduces cross-query contradictions (SetCons: 0.56 to 0.94) while preserving per-query accuracy, demonstrating that global coherence is critical for robust multi-query reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种解决大语言模型在多查询推理中逻辑不一致性的方法，通过提取承诺、验证全局可满足性和反例引导修复来确保跨查询的一致性
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在处理多个相关查询时经常产生相互矛盾的答案，需要研究如何在相互依赖的查询中维护全局可满足的信念状态
AI.method: 引入包含390个多查询推理实例的基准测试，提出集合级评估指标，采用求解器增强方法：提取承诺、验证全局可满足性、进行反例引导修复
AI.result: 在四个推理领域中，该方法显著减少了跨查询矛盾（SetCons从0.56提升到0.94），同时保持了每个查询的准确性
AI.conclusion: 全局一致性对于稳健的多查询推理至关重要，提出的方法能有效提高大语言模型在多查询场景下的逻辑一致性

title: When PCOS Meets Eating Disorders: An Explainable AI Approach to Detecting the Hidden Triple Burden
summary: Women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) face substantially elevated risks of body image distress, disordered eating, and metabolic challenges, yet existing natural language processing approaches for detecting these conditions lack transparency and cannot identify co-occurring presentations. We developed small, open-source language models to automatically detect this triple burden in social media posts with grounded explainability. We collected 1,000 PCOS-related posts from six subreddits, with two trained annotators labeling posts using guidelines operationalizing Lee et al. (2017) clinical framework. Three models (Gemma-2-2B, Qwen3-1.7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation to generate structured explanations with textual evidence. The best model achieved 75.3 percent exact match accuracy on 150 held-out posts, with robust comorbidity detection and strong explainability. Performance declined with diagnostic complexity, indicating their best use is for screening rather than autonomous diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 开发小型开源语言模型，用于从社交媒体帖子中检测PCOS患者的三重负担（身体形象困扰、饮食失调、代谢挑战），并提供可解释的证据。
AI.motivation: PCOS患者面临身体形象困扰、饮食失调和代谢挑战的三重负担，现有NLP方法缺乏透明度且无法识别共病表现，需要开发可解释的检测工具。
AI.method: 从6个subreddit收集1000个PCOS相关帖子，由两名训练有素的标注员使用Lee等人(2017)临床框架进行标注。使用三种模型(Gemma-2-2B, Qwen3-1.7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B)通过低秩适应进行微调，生成带有文本证据的结构化解释。
AI.result: 最佳模型在150个保留测试帖子上达到75.3%的精确匹配准确率，具有稳健的共病检测能力和强大的可解释性。性能随诊断复杂性下降，表明最适合用于筛查而非自主诊断。
AI.conclusion: 开发的小型开源语言模型能够有效检测PCOS三重负担，提供可解释的证据，适合作为筛查工具，但诊断复杂性会影响性能，不适用于自主诊断。

title: Dissecting Failure Dynamics in Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance through extended inference-time deliberation, yet how their reasoning failures arise remains poorly understood. By analyzing model-generated reasoning trajectories, we find that errors are not uniformly distributed but often originate from a small number of early transition points, after which reasoning remains locally coherent but globally incorrect. These transitions coincide with localized spikes in token-level entropy, and alternative continuations from the same intermediate state can still lead to correct solutions. Based on these observations, we introduce GUARD, a targeted inference-time framework that probes and redirects critical transitions using uncertainty signals. Empirical evaluations across multiple benchmarks confirm that interventions guided by these failure dynamics lead to more reliable reasoning outcomes. Our findings highlight the importance of understanding when and how reasoning first deviates, complementing existing approaches that focus on scaling inference-time computation.

AI.tldr: GUARD：基于不确定性信号探测和重定向关键推理转折点的推理时框架，通过识别早期错误转折点来提升大语言模型的推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型通过扩展推理时深思熟虑获得强大性能，但其推理失败如何产生仍不清楚。研究发现错误并非均匀分布，而是源于少数早期转折点，之后推理保持局部连贯但全局错误。
AI.method: 通过分析模型生成的推理轨迹，发现错误与标记级熵的局部峰值重合，从相同中间状态的替代延续仍可得到正确解。基于此引入GUARD框架，利用不确定性信号探测和重定向关键转折点。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的实证评估证实，基于这些失败动态指导的干预能带来更可靠的推理结果。转折点与局部熵峰值相关，从相同中间状态的替代延续可导向正确解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 理解推理何时及如何首次偏离至关重要，这补充了现有专注于扩展推理时计算的方法。GUARD框架通过识别和干预早期关键转折点，提高了大语言模型的推理可靠性。

title: The Cost of Language: Centroid Erasure Exposes and Exploits Modal Competition in Multimodal Language Models
summary: Multimodal language models systematically underperform on visual perception tasks, yet the structure underlying this failure remains poorly understood. We propose centroid replacement, collapsing each token to its nearest K-means centroid, as a controlled probe for modal dependence. Across seven models spanning three architecture families, erasing text centroid structure costs 4$\times$ more accuracy than erasing visual centroid structure, exposing a universal imbalance where language representations overshadow vision even on tasks that demand visual reasoning. We exploit this asymmetry through text centroid contrastive decoding, recovering up to +16.9% accuracy on individual tasks by contrastively decoding against a text-centroid-erased reference. This intervention varies meaningfully with training approaches: standard fine-tuned models show larger gains (+5.6% on average) than preference-optimized models (+1.5% on average). Our findings suggest that modal competition is structurally localized, correctable at inference time without retraining, and quantifiable as a diagnostic signal to guide future multimodal training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出质心替换方法，通过将token替换为最近的K-means质心来探测多模态模型中的模态依赖不平衡问题，发现语言表示在视觉推理任务中仍占主导地位，并利用文本质心对比解码在推理时无需重新训练即可提升性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型在视觉感知任务上系统性表现不佳，但其失败背后的结构机制尚不清楚。研究者希望探究模态依赖的不平衡问题，特别是语言表示如何主导视觉推理任务。
AI.method: 提出质心替换方法，将每个token替换为其最近的K-means质心，作为模态依赖的受控探针。在涵盖三种架构家族的七个模型上进行实验，通过文本质心对比解码，在推理时对比解码文本质心被擦除的参考模型来提升性能。
AI.result: 擦除文本质心结构比擦除视觉质心结构多损失4倍准确率，揭示了语言表示在视觉推理任务中仍占主导的普遍不平衡。通过文本质心对比解码，在单个任务上恢复高达+16.9%的准确率。标准微调模型平均增益更大(+5.6%)，偏好优化模型增益较小(+1.5%)。
AI.conclusion: 模态竞争在结构上是局部化的，可以在推理时无需重新训练进行纠正，并可量化为指导未来多模态训练的诊断信号。质心替换为理解多模态模型中的模态依赖提供了有效工具。

title: MARS$^2$: Scaling Multi-Agent Tree Search via Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) paradigms have demonstrated strong performance on reasoning-intensive tasks such as code generation. However, limited trajectory diversity often leads to diminishing returns, which constrains the achievable performance ceiling. Search-enhanced RL alleviates this issue by introducing structured exploration, which remains constrained by the single-agent policy priors. Meanwhile, leveraging multiple interacting policies can acquire more diverse exploratory signals, but existing approaches are typically decoupled from structured search. We propose \textbf{MARS$^2$} (Multi-Agent Reinforced Tree-Search Scaling), a unified RL framework in which multiple independently-optimized agents collaborate within a shared tree-structured search environment. MARS$^2$ models the search tree as a learnable multi-agent interaction environment, enabling heterogeneous agents to collaboratively generate and refine candidate solutions within a shared search topology. To support effective learning, we introduce a path-level group advantage formulation based on tree-consistent reward shaping, which facilitates effective credit assignment across complex search trajectories. Experiments on code generation benchmarks show that MARS$^2$ consistently improves performance across diverse model combinations and training settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of coupling multi-agent collaboration with tree search for enhancing reinforcement learning. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/TsinghuaC3I/MARTI.

AI.tldr: MARS²是一个将多智能体协作与树搜索统一起来的强化学习框架，通过在共享树结构搜索环境中让多个独立优化的智能体协作，解决代码生成等推理密集型任务中轨迹多样性不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习在代码生成等推理密集型任务中存在轨迹多样性有限的问题，导致性能提升受限。搜索增强的RL虽然通过结构化探索缓解了这一问题，但仍受限于单智能体策略先验。现有的多智能体方法能够获得更多样化的探索信号，但通常与结构化搜索解耦。
AI.method: 提出MARS²框架，将搜索树建模为可学习的多智能体交互环境，让异构智能体在共享搜索拓扑中协作生成和优化候选解。引入基于树一致奖励塑形的路径级群体优势公式，支持复杂搜索轨迹的有效信用分配。
AI.result: 在代码生成基准测试中，MARS²在不同模型组合和训练设置下均能持续提升性能，证明了将多智能体协作与树搜索耦合对增强强化学习的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MARS²通过统一多智能体协作与树搜索，解决了强化学习中轨迹多样性不足的问题，为推理密集型任务提供了有效的强化学习框架。

title: BiCon-Gate: Consistency-Gated De-colloquialisation for Dialogue Fact-Checking
summary: Automated fact-checking in dialogue involves multi-turn conversations where colloquial language is frequent yet understudied. To address this gap, we propose a conservative rewrite candidate for each response claim via staged de-colloquialisation, combining lightweight surface normalisation with scoped in-claim coreference resolution. We then introduce BiCon-Gate, a semantics-aware consistency gate that selects the rewrite candidate only when it is semantically supported by the dialogue context, otherwise falling back to the original claim. This gated selection stabilises downstream fact-checking and yields gains in both evidence retrieval and fact verification. On the DialFact benchmark, our approach improves retrieval and verification, with particularly strong gains on SUPPORTS, and outperforms competitive baselines, including a decoder-based one-shot LLM rewrite that attempts to perform all de-colloquialisation steps in a single pass.

AI.tldr: 提出一种对话式事实核查方法，通过分阶段去口语化重写候选和语义感知一致性门控，提升证据检索和事实验证性能
AI.motivation: 对话式事实核查中，口语化语言频繁出现但研究不足，现有方法难以有效处理多轮对话中的非正式表达，需要专门的方法来处理口语化语言对事实核查的影响
AI.method: 1. 分阶段去口语化重写：结合轻量级表面规范化与限定范围内的指代消解，为每个响应声明生成保守的重写候选；2. BiCon-Gate语义感知一致性门控：当重写候选得到对话上下文语义支持时选择重写版本，否则回退到原始声明，以稳定下游事实核查
AI.result: 在DialFact基准测试中，该方法在证据检索和事实验证方面均有提升，特别是在SUPPORTS类别上表现突出，优于包括基于解码器的一次性LLM重写在内的竞争基线
AI.conclusion: 提出的分阶段去口语化重写与语义感知一致性门控方法能有效处理对话中的口语化语言，提升事实核查系统的性能，证明了保守重写与上下文感知选择的重要性

title: Enhancing Mental Health Counseling Support in Bangladesh using Culturally-Grounded Knowledge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in generating supportive responses for mental health and counseling applications. However, their responses often lack cultural sensitivity, contextual grounding, and clinically appropriate guidance. This work addresses the gap of how to systematically incorporate domain-specific, clinically validated knowledge into LLMs to improve counseling quality. We utilize and compare two approaches, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and a knowledge graph (KG)-based method, designed to support para-counselors. Our KG is constructed manually and clinically validated, capturing causal relationships between stressors, interventions, and outcomes, with contributions from multidisciplinary people. We evaluated multiple LLMs in both settings using BERTScore F1 and SBERT cosine similarity, as well as human evaluation across five metrics, which is designed to directly measure the effectiveness of counseling beyond similarity at the surface level. The results show that KG-based approaches consistently improve contextual relevance, clinical appropriateness, and practical usability compared to RAG alone, demonstrating that structured, expert-validated knowledge plays a critical role in addressing LLMs limitations in counseling tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了检索增强生成(RAG)和知识图谱(KG)两种方法，将临床验证的咨询知识整合到LLMs中，以提升心理咨询响应的文化敏感性、情境基础和临床适切性。KG方法在多个评估指标上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在心理健康咨询应用中显示出潜力，但其响应通常缺乏文化敏感性、情境基础和临床适切的指导。需要系统性地将领域特定的临床验证知识整合到LLMs中，以提升咨询质量。
AI.method: 采用并比较两种方法：检索增强生成(RAG)和知识图谱(KG)方法。KG是手动构建并经过临床验证的，捕捉了压力源、干预措施和结果之间的因果关系，由多学科团队贡献。使用BERTScore F1和SBERT余弦相似度评估多个LLMs，同时进行人工评估，设计了五个直接衡量咨询效果而非表面相似性的指标。
AI.result: 结果显示，与单独的RAG相比，基于知识图谱的方法在情境相关性、临床适切性和实际可用性方面持续提升。这表明结构化、专家验证的知识在解决LLMs在咨询任务中的局限性方面起着关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、专家验证的知识图谱方法能有效提升LLMs在心理咨询任务中的表现，特别是在情境相关性、临床适切性和实用性方面，为解决LLMs在专业领域的局限性提供了有效途径。

title: Generating Concept Lexicalizations via Dictionary-Based Cross-Lingual Sense Projection
comment: To be published in the proceedings of Canadian AI 2026
summary: We study the task of automatically expanding WordNet-style lexical resources to new languages through sense generation. We generate senses by associating target-language lemmas with existing lexical concepts via semantic projection. Given a sense-tagged English corpus and its translation, our method projects English synsets onto aligned target-language tokens and assigns the corresponding lemmas to those synsets. To generate these alignments and ensure their quality, we augment a pre-trained base aligner with a bilingual dictionary, which is also used to filter out incorrect sense projections. We evaluate the method on multiple languages, comparing it to prior methods, as well as dictionary-based and large language model baselines. Results show that the proposed project-and-filter strategy improves precision while remaining interpretable and requiring few external resources. We plan to make our code, documentation, and generated sense inventories accessible.

AI.tldr: 通过语义投影自动扩展WordNet式词汇资源到新语言的方法，利用对齐的语料库将英语同义词集映射到目标语言词元，并通过双语词典过滤错误投影
AI.motivation: 解决多语言词汇资源扩展的自动化问题，特别是WordNet式词汇资源在新语言中的构建，避免传统方法的高成本和时间消耗
AI.method: 基于语义投影的方法：1) 使用带有词义标注的英语语料库及其翻译；2) 将英语同义词集投影到对齐的目标语言词元上；3) 通过双语词典增强预训练对齐器并过滤错误的词义投影
AI.result: 在多种语言上评估显示，提出的投影-过滤策略提高了精度，同时保持可解释性且需要较少外部资源，优于先前方法、基于词典的方法和大语言模型基线
AI.conclusion: 该方法为自动扩展多语言词汇资源提供了一种有效途径，计划公开代码、文档和生成的词义清单

title: The Autocorrelation Blind Spot: Why 42% of Turn-Level Findings in LLM Conversation Analysis May Be Spurious
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables, 1 algorithm. Code and synthetic demonstration data: https://github.com/ferdinandschessl-boop/autocorrelation-correction
summary: Turn-level metrics are widely used to evaluate properties of multi-turn human-LLM conversations, from safety and sycophancy to dialogue quality. However, consecutive turns within a conversation are not statistically independent -- a fact that virtually all current evaluation pipelines fail to correct for in their statistical inference. We systematically characterize the autocorrelation structure of 66 turn-level metrics across 202 multi-turn conversations (11,639 turn pairs, 5 German-speaking users, 4 LLM platforms) and demonstrate that naive pooled analysis produces severely inflated significance estimates: 42% of associations that appear significant under standard pooled testing fail to survive cluster-robust correction. The inflation varies substantially across categories rather than scaling linearly with autocorrelation: three memoryless families (embedding velocity, directional, differential) aggregate to 14%, while the seven non-memoryless families (thermo-cycle, frame distance, lexical/structural, rolling windows, cumulative, interaction, timestamp) aggregate to 33%, with individual category rates ranging from 0% to 100% depending on per-family effect size. We present a two-stage correction framework combining Chelton (1983) effective degrees of freedom with conversation-level block bootstrap, and validate it on a pre-registered hold-out split where cluster-robust metrics replicate at 57% versus 30% for pooled-only metrics. We provide concrete design principles, a publication checklist, and open-source code for the correction pipeline. A survey of ~30 recent papers at major NLP and AI venues that compute turn-level statistics in LLM evaluations finds that only 4 address temporal dependence at all, and 26 do not correct for it.

AI.tldr: 论文指出当前多轮对话评估中普遍忽视相邻轮次间的自相关性，导致统计推断严重失真，提出了两阶段校正框架并验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前多轮人-LLM对话评估中广泛使用轮次级指标，但几乎所有现有评估流程都忽略了连续轮次间的统计依赖性，导致统计推断出现严重偏差，需要系统性地解决这一问题。
AI.method: 系统分析了66个轮次级指标在202个多轮对话中的自相关结构，提出了结合Chelton有效自由度与对话级块自助法的两阶段校正框架，并在预注册的保留集上验证了其有效性。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）标准池化分析导致显著性估计严重膨胀，42%在标准池化检验下显著的关联在校正后不再显著；2）膨胀程度因指标类别而异，非记忆型指标家族膨胀率更高；3）校正后的聚类稳健指标在保留集上的可复制率为57%，远高于未校正指标的30%。
AI.conclusion: 多轮对话评估必须考虑时间依赖性，提出的校正框架能有效解决统计推断偏差问题，并为该领域提供了具体的设计原则、发表检查清单和开源代码。

title: GDPR Auto-Formalization with AI Agents and Human Verification
summary: We study the overall process of automatic formalization of GDPR provisions using large language models, within a human-in-the-loop verification framework. Rather than aiming for full autonomy, we adopt a role-specialized workflow in which LLM-based AI components, operating in a multi-agent setting with iterative feedback, generate legal scenarios, formal rules, and atomic facts. This is coupled with independent verification modules which include human reviewers' assessment of representational, logical, and legal correctness. Using this approach, we construct a high-quality dataset to be used for GDPR auto-formalization, and analyze both successful and problematic cases. Our results show that structured verification and targeted human oversight are essential for reliable legal formalization, especially in the presence of legal nuance and context-sensitive reasoning.

AI.tldr: 研究使用大语言模型在人类参与验证框架下自动形式化GDPR条款的整体过程，采用角色专业化工作流，结合独立验证模块构建高质量数据集
AI.motivation: 研究如何利用大语言模型自动形式化GDPR条款，但认识到完全自主的局限性，因此采用人类参与验证框架以确保法律形式化的可靠性和准确性
AI.method: 采用角色专业化工作流，在多智能体设置中使用LLM生成法律场景、形式规则和原子事实，结合独立验证模块（包括人类评审员对表示、逻辑和法律正确性的评估），构建迭代反馈机制
AI.result: 构建了用于GDPR自动形式化的高质量数据集，分析了成功和问题案例，结果表明结构化验证和针对性人类监督对于可靠的法律形式化至关重要，特别是在存在法律细微差别和上下文敏感推理的情况下
AI.conclusion: 结构化验证和人类监督是可靠法律形式化的关键，尤其是在处理法律细微差别和上下文敏感推理时，多智能体设置与迭代反馈机制结合人类评审能有效提升自动形式化的质量

title: Hierarchical vs. Flat Iteration in Shared-Weight Transformers
summary: We present an empirical study of whether hierarchically structured, shared-weight recurrence can match the representational quality of independent-layer stacking in a Transformer-based language model. HRM-LM replaces L independent Transformer layers with a two-speed recurrent pair: a Fast module operating at every step for local refinement, and a Slow module operating every T steps for global compression. This recurrent hierarchy is unrolled for M = N x T steps with shared parameters. The central and most robust finding, supported by a parameter-matched Universal Transformer ablation (UniTF, 1.2B) across five independent runs, is a sharp empirical gap between the two approaches.

AI.tldr: HRM-LM使用分层共享权重的循环结构替代传统Transformer的独立层堆叠，通过快慢双模块的循环机制实现局部细化和全局压缩，但实验发现其表征能力与独立层堆叠存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 研究分层结构、共享权重的循环机制是否能在Transformer语言模型中达到与独立层堆叠相同的表征质量，探索更高效的模型架构。
AI.method: HRM-LM用两速循环对（Fast模块每步操作进行局部细化，Slow模块每T步操作进行全局压缩）替代L个独立Transformer层。该循环层次结构以共享参数展开M = N x T步，并与参数匹配的Universal Transformer消融实验（UniTF, 1.2B）进行对比。
AI.result: 核心且最稳健的发现是两种方法之间存在显著的实证差距，这一发现在五个独立运行的参数匹配实验中均得到支持。
AI.conclusion: 分层共享权重的循环结构在表征质量上无法匹配独立层堆叠的Transformer架构，表明当前循环机制在语言建模任务中存在局限性。

title: CoDaS: AI Co-Data-Scientist for Biomarker Discovery via Wearable Sensors
summary: Scientific discovery in digital health requires converting continuous physiological signals from wearable devices into clinically actionable biomarkers. We introduce CoDaS (AI Co-Data-Scientist), a multi-agent system that structures biomarker discovery as an iterative process combining hypothesis generation, statistical analysis, adversarial validation, and literature-grounded reasoning with human oversight using large-scale wearable datasets. Across three cohorts totaling 9,279 participant-observations, CoDaS identified 41 candidate digital biomarkers for mental health and 25 for metabolic outcomes, each subjected to an internal validation battery spanning replication, stability, robustness, and discriminative power. Across two independent depression cohorts, CoDaS surfaced circadian instability-related features in both datasets, reflected in sleep duration variability (DWB, ρ= 0.252, p < 0.001) and sleep onset variability (GLOBEM, ρ= 0.126, p < 0.001). In a metabolic cohort, CoDaS derived a cardiovascular fitness index (steps/resting heart rate; ρ= -0.374, p < 0.001), and recovered established clinical associations, including the hepatic function ratio (AST/ALT; ρ= -0.375, p < 0.001), a known correlate of insulin resistance. Incorporating CoDaS-derived features alongside demographic variables led to modest but consistent improvements in predictive performance, with cross-validated ΔR^2 increases of 0.040 for depression and 0.021 for insulin resistance. These findings suggest that CoDaS enables systematic and traceable hypothesis generation and prioritization for biomarker discovery from large-scale wearable data.

AI.tldr: CoDaS是一个多智能体系统，用于从可穿戴设备数据中发现数字生物标志物，通过假设生成、统计分析、对抗验证和文献推理的迭代过程，在心理健康和代谢结果方面识别出多个候选生物标志物。
AI.motivation: 数字健康领域的科学发现需要将可穿戴设备的连续生理信号转化为临床可操作的生物标志物，但目前缺乏系统化的方法来从大规模可穿戴数据中发现和验证这些生物标志物。
AI.method: CoDaS是一个多智能体系统，采用迭代过程结合假设生成、统计分析、对抗验证和基于文献的推理，并辅以人工监督，使用大规模可穿戴数据集进行生物标志物发现。
AI.result: 在三个队列共9,279个参与者观察中，CoDaS识别出41个心理健康候选数字生物标志物和25个代谢结果候选生物标志物。在抑郁队列中发现了昼夜节律不稳定性相关特征，在代谢队列中推导出心血管健康指数并恢复了已知的临床关联。加入CoDaS衍生特征后，预测性能有适度但一致的改善。
AI.conclusion: CoDaS能够从大规模可穿戴数据中实现系统化和可追溯的假设生成与优先级排序，为数字生物标志物发现提供了一种有效的方法。

title: A Parallel Approach to Counting Exact Covers Based on Decomposability Property
summary: The exact cover problem is a classical NP-hard problem with broad applications in the area of AI. Algorithm DXZ is a method to count exact covers representing by zero-suppressed binary decision diagrams (ZBDDs). In this paper, we propose a zero-suppressed variant of decision decomposable negation normal form (in short, decision-ZDNNF), which is strictly more succinct than ZBDDs. We then design a novel parallel algorithm, namely DXD, which constructs a decision-ZDNNF representing the set of all exact covers. Furthermore, we improve DXD by dynamically updating connected components. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved DXD algorithm outperforms all of state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出决策-ZDNNF表示形式，比ZBDD更简洁，并设计并行算法DXD及其改进版本，用于精确覆盖问题的计数，性能优于现有方法
AI.motivation: 精确覆盖问题是NP难问题，在AI领域有广泛应用。现有方法DXZ使用ZBDD表示精确覆盖，但ZBDD表示能力有限，需要更简洁高效的表示形式和算法
AI.method: 1) 提出决策-ZDNNF（零抑制决策可分解否定范式），比ZBDD更简洁；2) 设计并行算法DXD构建决策-ZDNNF表示所有精确覆盖；3) 改进DXD算法，通过动态更新连通分量提升性能
AI.result: 实验结果表明，改进后的DXD算法在所有基准测试中都优于现有最先进方法
AI.conclusion: 决策-ZDNNF是比ZBDD更简洁的表示形式，基于此设计的DXD算法及其改进版本能有效解决精确覆盖计数问题，性能显著优于现有方法

title: Filling in the Mechanisms: How do LMs Learn Filler-Gap Dependencies under Developmental Constraints?
comment: To be published in the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
summary: For humans, filler-gap dependencies require a shared representation across different syntactic constructions. Although causal analyses suggest this may also be true for LLMs (Boguraev et al., 2025), it is still unclear if such a representation also exists for language models trained on developmentally feasible quantities of data. We applied Distributed Alignment Search (DAS, Geiger et al. (2024)) to LMs trained on varying amounts of data from the BabyLM challenge (Warstadt et al., 2023), to evaluate whether representations of filler-gap dependencies transfer between wh-questions and topicalization, which greatly vary in terms of their input frequency. Our results suggest shared, yet item-sensitive mechanisms may develop with limited training data. More importantly, LMs still require far more data than humans to learn comparable generalizations, highlighting the need for language-specific biases in models of language acquisition.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用分布式对齐搜索方法分析在不同数据量下训练的语言模型，探讨填充语-空位依赖关系在wh疑问句和话题化结构中的共享表征机制，发现模型需要比人类多得多的数据才能获得类似的语言泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究语言模型是否能在发展上可行的数据量下学习到填充语-空位依赖关系的共享表征。虽然因果分析表明大语言模型可能存在这种表征，但尚不清楚在有限训练数据下是否也能形成这种跨句法结构的共享机制。
AI.method: 采用分布式对齐搜索方法，应用于在不同数据量下训练的语言模型。这些模型使用BabyLM挑战赛的数据进行训练，评估填充语-空位依赖关系在wh疑问句和话题化结构之间的表征迁移，这两种结构在输入频率上有很大差异。
AI.result: 结果表明，即使在有限训练数据下，也可能发展出共享但项目敏感的机制。更重要的是，语言模型需要比人类多得多的数据才能学习到可比较的语言泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了在语言习得模型中需要语言特定偏置的重要性。语言模型需要远超人类的数据量才能获得类似的语言泛化，这揭示了当前模型在语言习得效率方面的局限性。

title: Learning to Draw ASCII Improves Spatial Reasoning in Language Models
summary: When faced with complex spatial problems, humans naturally sketch layouts to organize their thinking, and the act of drawing further sharpens their understanding. In this work, we ask whether a similar principle holds for Large Language Models (LLMs): can learning to construct explicit visual layouts from spatial descriptions instill genuine spatial understanding? We introduce Text2Space, a dataset that pairs natural language descriptions with ground-truth ASCII grid layouts and spatial QA pairs, enabling us to separate failures in constructing spatial representations from failures in reasoning over them. We adopt ASCII because it is human-readable, operates entirely within the token space of language models, and encodes spatial relations in a structurally verifiable form. Our evaluation reveals a pronounced "Read-Write Asymmetry": LLMs interpret ASCII representations effectively but struggle to produce them from text, and these construction errors propagate to incorrect answers downstream. To address this limitation, we train models on layout construction (Text$\rightarrow$ASCII) and find that it significantly improves spatial reasoning from text alone, even without producing any ASCII at inference time. Combining construction with comprehension training further amplifies these gains. Crucially, these improvements transfer to three external spatial reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that, much as sketching sharpens human spatial thinking, learning to construct explicit layouts instills spatial understanding that generalizes beyond the training format.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Text2Space数据集，研究LLMs通过构建ASCII网格布局来学习空间理解，发现"读写不对称"现象，训练布局构建能显著提升空间推理能力并迁移到其他基准测试。
AI.motivation: 研究人类通过绘制草图来组织空间思维的现象是否适用于大语言模型，探索LLMs通过构建显式视觉布局是否能获得真正的空间理解能力。
AI.method: 引入Text2Space数据集（自然语言描述+ASCII网格布局+空间QA对），采用ASCII表示（人类可读、在token空间内、结构可验证），训练模型进行布局构建（Text→ASCII）和空间推理。
AI.result: 发现显著的"读写不对称"现象：LLMs能有效解释ASCII表示但难以从文本生成它们；布局构建训练显著提升纯文本空间推理能力；结合构建与理解训练效果更佳；改进能迁移到三个外部空间推理基准测试。
AI.conclusion: 如同草图绘制能增强人类空间思维，学习构建显式布局能培养LLMs的空间理解能力，这种能力能泛化到训练格式之外，为提升模型空间推理提供了有效方法。

title: Psychological Steering of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) emulate a consistent human-like behavior that can be shaped through activation-level interventions. This paradigm is converging on additive residual-stream injections, which rely on injection-strength sweeps to approximate optimal intervention settings. However, existing methods restrict the search space and sweep in uncalibrated activation-space units, potentially missing optimal intervention conditions. Thus, we introduce a psychological steering framework that performs unbounded, fluency-constrained sweeps in semantically calibrated units. Our method derives and calibrates residual-stream injections using psychological artifacts, and we use the IPIP-NEO-120, which measures the OCEAN personality model, to compare six injection methods. We find that mean-difference (MD) injections outperform Personality Prompting (P$^2$), an established baseline for OCEAN steering, in open-ended generation in 11 of 14 LLMs, with gains of 3.6\% to 16.4\%, overturning prior reports favoring prompting and positioning representation engineering as a new frontier in open-ended psychological steering. Further, we find that a hybrid of P$^2$ and MD injections outperforms both methods in 13 of 14 LLMs, with gains over P$^2$ ranging from 5.6\% to 21.9\% and from 3.3\% to 26.7\% over MD injections. Finally, we show that MD injections align with the Linear Representation Hypothesis and provide reliable, approximately linear control knobs for psychological steering. Nevertheless, they also induce OCEAN trait covariance patterns that depart from the Big Two model, suggesting a gap between learned representations and human psychology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种心理引导框架，通过语义校准单位进行无界、流畅性约束的扫描，使用IPIP-NEO-120测量OCEAN人格模型，比较六种注入方法，发现均值差注入在14个LLM中的11个优于人格提示，混合方法表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型激活级干预方法限制搜索空间并在未校准的激活空间单位中进行扫描，可能错过最优干预条件，需要一种能够进行无界、流畅性约束扫描的语义校准方法。
AI.method: 提出心理引导框架，使用心理人工制品推导和校准残差流注入，采用IPIP-NEO-120测量OCEAN人格模型，比较六种注入方法，包括均值差注入和人格提示的混合方法。
AI.result: 均值差注入在14个LLM中的11个优于人格提示，性能提升3.6%至16.4%；混合方法在13个LLM中优于两种方法，相比人格提示提升5.6%至21.9%，相比均值差注入提升3.3%至26.7%；均值差注入符合线性表示假设，但诱导的OCEAN特质协方差模式偏离Big Two模型。
AI.conclusion: 表示工程是开放式心理引导的新前沿，均值差注入提供了可靠、近似线性的心理引导控制旋钮，但学习到的表示与人类心理学之间存在差距，混合方法展示了结合不同干预策略的优势。

title: Targeted Exploration via Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted for publication in Findings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, the widely used Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) consistently suffers from entropy collapse, causing the policy to converge prematurely and lose diversity. Existing exploration methods introduce additional bias or variance during exploration, making it difficult to maintain optimization stability. We propose Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning (UEC-RL), a framework that provides targeted mechanisms for exploration and stabilization. UEC-RL activates more exploration on difficult prompts to search for potential and valuable reasoning trajectories. In parallel, a stabilizer prevents entropy from growing uncontrollably, thereby keeping training stable as the model consolidates reliable behaviors. Together, these components expand the search space when needed while maintaining robust optimization throughout training. Experiments on both LLM and VLM reasoning tasks show consistent gains over RL baselines on both Pass@1 and Pass@$k$. On Geometry3K, UEC-RL achieves a 37.9\% relative improvement over GRPO, indicating that it sustains effective exploration without compromising convergence and underscoring UEC-RL as a key for scaling RL-based reasoning in large models. Our code is available at https://github.com/597358816/UEC-RL.

AI.tldr: UEC-RL框架通过统一熵控制解决强化学习中熵崩溃问题，在困难提示上激活探索同时防止熵失控，提升LLM和VLM推理能力
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法如GRPO存在熵崩溃问题，导致策略过早收敛、失去多样性；现有探索方法引入额外偏差或方差，难以保持优化稳定性
AI.method: 提出统一熵控制强化学习框架UEC-RL，包含两个核心组件：1）在困难提示上激活更多探索以搜索潜在有价值的推理轨迹；2）稳定器防止熵失控增长，在模型巩固可靠行为时保持训练稳定
AI.result: 在LLM和VLM推理任务上，UEC-RL相比RL基线在Pass@1和Pass@k指标上均取得一致提升；在Geometry3K任务上，相比GRPO获得37.9%的相对改进
AI.conclusion: UEC-RL能够在不损害收敛性的情况下维持有效探索，是扩展基于强化学习的大模型推理能力的关键方法

title: CobwebTM: Probabilistic Concept Formation for Lifelong and Hierarchical Topic Modeling
summary: Topic modeling seeks to uncover latent semantic structure in text corpora with minimal supervision. Neural approaches achieve strong performance but require extensive tuning and struggle with lifelong learning due to catastrophic forgetting and fixed capacity, while classical probabilistic models lack flexibility and adaptability to streaming data. We introduce \textsc{CobwebTM}, a low-parameter lifelong hierarchical topic model based on incremental probabilistic concept formation. By adapting the Cobweb algorithm to continuous document embeddings, \textsc{CobwebTM} constructs semantic hierarchies online, enabling unsupervised topic discovery, dynamic topic creation, and hierarchical organization without predefining the number of topics. Across diverse datasets, \textsc{CobwebTM} achieves strong topic coherence, stable topics over time, and high-quality hierarchies, demonstrating that incremental symbolic concept formation combined with pretrained representations is an efficient approach to topic modeling.

AI.tldr: CobwebTM：基于增量概率概念形成的低参数终身分层主题模型，利用预训练表示实现无监督主题发现、动态主题创建和分层组织
AI.motivation: 神经方法需要大量调参且存在灾难性遗忘问题，而经典概率模型缺乏灵活性和对流式数据的适应性，需要一种能在线构建语义层次、无需预定义主题数量的终身学习主题模型
AI.method: 将Cobweb算法适配到连续文档嵌入，基于增量概率概念形成构建语义层次，在线进行无监督主题发现、动态主题创建和分层组织
AI.result: 在多个数据集上实现了强主题连贯性、随时间稳定的主题和高质量层次结构，表明增量符号概念形成与预训练表示结合是主题建模的有效方法
AI.conclusion: CobwebTM通过结合增量符号概念形成和预训练表示，提供了一种高效的主题建模方法，能够在线构建语义层次、动态创建主题，且无需预定义主题数量

title: PeerPrism: Peer Evaluation Expertise vs Review-writing AI
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in scientific peer review, assisting with drafting, rewriting, expansion, and refinement. However, existing peer-review LLM detection methods largely treat authorship as a binary problem-human vs. AI-without accounting for the hybrid nature of modern review workflows. In practice, evaluative ideas and surface realization may originate from different sources, creating a spectrum of human-AI collaboration.
  In this work, we introduce PeerPrism, a large-scale benchmark of 20,690 peer reviews explicitly designed to disentangle idea provenance from text provenance. We construct controlled generation regimes spanning fully human, fully synthetic, and multiple hybrid transformations. This design enables systematic evaluation of whether detectors identify the origin of the surface text or the origin of the evaluative reasoning. We benchmark state-of-the-art LLM text detection methods on PeerPrism. While several methods achieve high accuracy on the standard binary task (human vs. fully synthetic), their predictions diverge sharply under hybrid regimes. In particular, when ideas originate from humans but the surface text is AI-generated, detectors frequently disagree and produce contradictory classifications. Accompanied by stylometric and semantic analyses, our results show that current detection methods conflate surface realization with intellectual contribution.
  Overall, we demonstrate that LLM detection in peer review cannot be reduced to a binary attribution problem. Instead, authorship must be modeled as a multidimensional construct spanning semantic reasoning and stylistic realization. PeerPrism is the first benchmark evaluating human-AI collaboration in these settings. We release all code, data, prompts, and evaluation scripts to facilitate reproducible research at https://github.com/Reviewerly-Inc/PeerPrism.

AI.tldr: PeerPrism是一个包含20,690篇同行评审的大规模基准数据集，旨在区分思想来源与文本来源，评估LLM检测方法在混合人机协作场景下的表现，发现现有方法混淆了表面文本与智力贡献。
AI.motivation: 当前同行评审中的LLM检测方法主要将作者身份视为二元问题（人类vs.AI），未能考虑现代评审工作流程中人类与AI混合协作的实际情况，需要开发能够区分思想来源与文本来源的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建PeerPrism基准数据集，包含20,690篇同行评审，采用受控生成机制涵盖完全人类撰写、完全AI生成以及多种混合转换（如人类思想+AI文本表达、AI思想+人类重写等），系统评估现有LLM文本检测方法在不同协作模式下的表现。
AI.result: 现有检测方法在标准二元任务（人类vs.完全合成）上表现良好，但在混合协作场景下预测结果出现显著分歧；特别是当思想来自人类而表面文本由AI生成时，检测器经常产生矛盾分类；风格计量和语义分析表明当前方法混淆了表面实现与智力贡献。
AI.conclusion: 同行评审中的LLM检测不能简化为二元归属问题，作者身份应建模为涵盖语义推理和风格实现的多维结构；PeerPrism是首个评估此类人机协作场景的基准，为可重复研究提供了完整的数据、代码和评估脚本。

title: Mechanistic Decoding of Cognitive Constructs in LLMs
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate increasingly sophisticated affective capabilities, the internal mechanisms by which they process complex emotions remain unclear. Existing interpretability approaches often treat models as black boxes or focus on coarse-grained basic emotions, leaving the cognitive structure of more complex affective states underexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose a Cognitive Reverse-Engineering framework based on Representation Engineering (RepE) to analyze social-comparison jealousy. By combining appraisal theory with subspace orthogonalization, regression-based weighting, and bidirectional causal steering, we isolate and quantify two psychological antecedents of jealousy, Superiority of Comparison Person and Domain Self-Definitional Relevance, and examine their causal effects on model judgments. Experiments on eight LLMs from the Llama, Qwen, and Gemma families suggest that models natively encode jealousy as a structured linear combination of these constituent factors. Their internal representations are broadly consistent with the human psychological construct, treating Superiority as the foundational trigger and Relevance as the ultimate intensity multiplier. Our framework also demonstrates that toxic emotional states can be mechanically detected and surgically suppressed, suggesting a possible route toward representational monitoring and intervention for AI safety in multi-agent environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于表征工程的认知逆向工程框架，用于分析大语言模型中复杂情感（社会比较嫉妒）的内部处理机制，发现模型将嫉妒编码为两个心理前因的线性组合，并展示了检测和抑制有毒情感状态的方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型展现出日益复杂的情感能力，但其处理复杂情感的内部机制仍不清楚。现有的可解释性方法通常将模型视为黑箱，或仅关注粗粒度的基本情感，对更复杂情感状态的认知结构探索不足。
AI.method: 提出了基于表征工程（RepE）的认知逆向工程框架，结合评价理论与子空间正交化、基于回归的加权和双向因果引导，分离并量化嫉妒的两个心理前因：比较对象的优越性和领域自我定义相关性，并检验它们对模型判断的因果效应。
AI.result: 在Llama、Qwen和Gemma家族的八个LLM上的实验表明，模型将嫉妒原生编码为这些构成因素的线性组合。其内部表征与人类心理结构基本一致，将优越性视为基础触发因素，相关性作为最终强度乘数。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了有毒情感状态可以被机械检测和精确抑制，为多智能体环境中AI安全的表征监控和干预提供了一条可能路径。

title: Acceptance Dynamics Across Cognitive Domains in Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference. It uses a small draft model to propose a tree of future tokens. A larger target model then verifies these tokens in a single batched forward pass. Despite the growing body of work on speculative methods, the degree to which the cognitive characteristics of a task affect acceptance probability remains largely unexplored. We present an empirical study of tree-based speculative decoding acceptance dynamics. Our study spans four well-established NLP benchmark domains: code generation, mathematical reasoning, logical reasoning, and open-ended chat. For this, we use TinyLlama-1.1B as the draft model against Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ as the target. Over 99,768 speculative nodes collected from 200 prompts, we derive per-domain acceptance rates, expected accepted lengths, depth-acceptance profiles, and entropy-acceptance correlations. We find that task type is a stronger predictor of acceptance than tree depth. Furthermore, only the chat domain consistently yields an expected accepted length exceeding 1.0 token per step. We also show that the entropy-acceptance correlation is consistently negative but weak across all domains (rho in [-0.20, -0.15]). Counterintuitively, chat produces the highest entropy yet the highest acceptance rate. We attribute this divergence to the lexical predictability of RLHF-aligned register. These findings have direct implications for domain-aware speculation budgets and draft-model selection strategies. Index Terms--speculative decoding, large language model inference, tree attention, draft model, acceptance probability, LLM efficiency

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实证分析探讨了树状推测解码在不同NLP任务中的接受率动态，发现任务类型比树深度更能预测接受率，且只有聊天领域能持续实现每步超过1个标记的接受长度。
AI.motivation: 尽管推测解码方法的研究日益增多，但任务认知特性对接受概率的影响程度仍未被充分探索。本研究旨在通过实证分析树状推测解码在不同NLP任务中的接受动态，填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 使用TinyLlama-1.1B作为草稿模型，Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ作为目标模型，在四个成熟的NLP基准领域（代码生成、数学推理、逻辑推理和开放聊天）收集99,768个推测节点。分析包括每领域接受率、期望接受长度、深度-接受分布以及熵-接受相关性。
AI.result: 任务类型比树深度更能预测接受率；只有聊天领域能持续实现每步超过1个标记的期望接受长度；熵-接受相关性在所有领域均为负但较弱（rho在[-0.20, -0.15]之间）；聊天领域产生最高熵却获得最高接受率，这归因于RLHF对齐注册的词汇可预测性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明任务认知特性显著影响推测解码性能，这些发现对领域感知的推测预算和草稿模型选择策略具有直接指导意义，强调了在推测解码优化中考虑任务类型的重要性。

title: NLP needs Diversity outside of 'Diversity'
summary: This position paper argues that recent progress with diversity in NLP is disproportionately concentrated on a small number of areas surrounding fairness. We further argue that this is the result of a number of incentives, biases, and barriers which come together to disenfranchise marginalized researchers in non-fairness fields, or to move them into fairness-related fields. We substantiate our claims with an investigation into the demographics of NLP researchers by subfield, using our research to support a number of recommendations for ensuring that all areas within NLP can become more inclusive and equitable. In particular, we highlight the importance of breaking down feedback loops that reinforce disparities, and the need to address geographical and linguistic barriers that hinder participation in NLP research.

AI.tldr: 该立场论文指出NLP领域多样性进展过度集中于少数公平性相关领域，这是由于激励、偏见和障碍导致边缘化研究者被排斥或转向公平性领域，论文通过子领域人口统计调查支持这一观点并提出促进包容性的建议。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在揭示NLP领域多样性进展的不均衡分布问题，特别关注公平性领域与其他子领域之间的差异，以及这种不均衡对边缘化研究者的影响。
AI.method: 采用立场论文形式，结合对NLP研究者按子领域进行的人口统计调查，分析激励结构、偏见和系统性障碍如何影响研究者的领域选择。
AI.result: 研究发现NLP多样性进展主要集中在少数公平性相关领域，存在系统性因素导致边缘化研究者在非公平性领域被边缘化或被迫转向公平性领域。
AI.conclusion: 提出打破强化不平等的反馈循环、解决地理和语言障碍等具体建议，以确保NLP所有子领域都能变得更加包容和公平。

title: CausalDetox: Causal Head Selection and Intervention for Language Model Detoxification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate toxic content, posing significant risks for safe deployment. Current mitigation strategies often degrade generation quality or require costly human annotation. We propose CAUSALDETOX, a framework that identifies and intervenes on the specific attention heads causally responsible for toxic generation. Using the Probability of Necessity and Sufficiency (PNS), we isolate a minimal set of heads that are necessary and sufficient for toxicity. We utilize these components via two complementary strategies: (1) Local Inference-Time Intervention, which constructs dynamic, input-specific steering vectors for context-aware detoxification, and (2) PNS-Guided Fine-Tuning, which permanently unlearns toxic representations. We also introduce PARATOX, a novel benchmark of aligned toxic/non-toxic sentence pairs enabling controlled counterfactual evaluation. Experiments on ToxiGen, ImplicitHate, and ParaDetox show that CAUSALDETOX achieves up to 5.34% greater toxicity reduction compared to baselines while preserving linguistic fluency, and offers a 7x speedup in head selection.

AI.tldr: CAUSALDETOX：通过因果干预注意力头实现大语言模型去毒化的框架，在保持生成质量的同时显著降低毒性
AI.motivation: 大语言模型经常生成有毒内容，现有缓解策略通常会降低生成质量或需要昂贵的人工标注，需要一种更有效的去毒化方法
AI.method: 使用必要性和充分性概率（PNS）识别导致毒性生成的特定注意力头，通过两种策略干预：局部推理时间干预（动态构建输入特定的导向向量）和PNS引导的微调（永久消除毒性表示）
AI.result: 在ToxiGen、ImplicitHate和ParaDetox数据集上，CAUSALDETOX相比基线实现高达5.34%的毒性降低，同时保持语言流畅性，注意力头选择速度提升7倍
AI.conclusion: CAUSALDETOX通过因果干预注意力头提供了一种有效的去毒化框架，在降低毒性的同时保持生成质量，并引入了PARATOX基准用于受控反事实评估

title: M2-PALE: A Framework for Explaining Multi-Agent MCTS--Minimax Hybrids via Process Mining and LLMs
summary: Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is a fundamental sampling-based search algorithm widely used for online planning in sequential decision-making domains. Despite its success in driving recent advances in artificial intelligence, understanding the behavior of MCTS agents remains a challenge for both developers and users. This difficulty stems from the complex search trees produced through the simulation of numerous future states and their intricate relationships. A known weakness of standard MCTS is its reliance on highly selective tree construction, which may lead to the omission of crucial moves and a vulnerability to tactical traps. To resolve this, we incorporate shallow, full-width Minimax search into the rollout phase of multi-agent MCTS to enhance strategic depth. Furthermore, to demystify the resulting decision-making logic, we introduce \textsf{M2-PALE} (MCTS--Minimax Process-Aided Linguistic Explanations). This framework employs process mining techniques, specifically the Alpha Miner, iDHM, and Inductive Miner algorithms, to extract underlying behavioral workflows from agent execution traces. These process models are then synthesized by LLMs to generate human-readable causal and distal explanations. We demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in a small-scale checkers environment, establishing a scalable foundation for interpreting hybrid agents in increasingly complex strategic domains.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合MCTS与浅层全宽度Minimax搜索的混合方法，并引入M2-PALE框架通过过程挖掘和LLM生成可解释的决策逻辑。
AI.motivation: MCTS在序列决策领域取得了成功，但其复杂搜索树使得理解智能体行为变得困难。标准MCTS存在高度选择性树构建的弱点，可能导致忽略关键走法和对战术陷阱的脆弱性。
AI.method: 1) 在多智能体MCTS的rollout阶段融入浅层全宽度Minimax搜索以增强战略深度；2) 提出M2-PALE框架，使用Alpha Miner、iDHM和Inductive Miner等过程挖掘算法从智能体执行轨迹中提取行为工作流；3) 利用LLM将过程模型合成为人类可读的因果和远端解释。
AI.result: 在小规模跳棋环境中验证了方法的有效性，为在日益复杂的战略领域中解释混合智能体建立了可扩展的基础。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合Minimax搜索增强MCTS的战略深度，并通过过程挖掘和LLM生成解释，为解决MCTS智能体行为理解难题提供了系统化框架。

title: Retrieve, Then Classify: Corpus-Grounded Automation of Clinical Value Set Authoring
summary: Clinical value set authoring -- the task of identifying all codes in a standardized vocabulary that define a clinical concept -- is a recurring bottleneck in clinical quality measurement and phenotyping. A natural approach is to prompt a large language model (LLM) to generate the required codes directly, but structured clinical vocabularies are large, version-controlled, and not reliably memorized during pretraining. We propose Retrieval-Augmented Set Completion (RASC): retrieve the $K$ most similar existing value sets from a curated corpus to form a candidate pool, then apply a classifier to each candidate code. Theoretically, retrieve-and-select can reduce statistical complexity by shrinking the effective output space from the full vocabulary to a much smaller retrieved candidate pool. We demonstrate the utility of RASC on 11,803 publicly available VSAC value sets, constructing the first large-scale benchmark for this task. A cross-encoder fine-tuned on SAPBert achieves AUROC~0.852 and value-set-level F1~0.298, outperforming a simpler three-layer Multilayer Perceptron (AUROC~0.799, F1~0.250) and both reduce the number of irrelevant candidates per true positive from 12.3 (retrieval-only) to approximately 3.2 and 4.4 respectively. Zero-shot GPT-4o achieves value-set-level F1~0.105, with 48.6\% of returned codes absent from VSAC entirely. This performance gap widens with increasing value set size, consistent with RASC's theoretical advantage. We observe similar performance gains across two other classifier model types, namely a cross-encoder initialized from pre-trained SAPBert and a LightGBM model, demonstrating that RASC's benefits extend beyond a single model class. The code to download and create the benchmark dataset, as well as the model training code is available at: \href{https://github.com/mukhes3/RASC}{https://github.com/mukhes3/RASC}.

AI.tldr: 提出RASC方法用于临床价值集构建，通过检索相似价值集形成候选池，再用分类器筛选代码，相比直接使用LLM生成显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 临床价值集构建是临床质量测量和表型分析中的瓶颈任务。直接使用大语言模型生成标准化词汇代码存在局限性，因为临床词汇库庞大、版本控制且预训练时未可靠记忆。
AI.method: 提出检索增强集合补全(RASC)方法：首先从已标注语料库中检索K个最相似的现有价值集形成候选代码池，然后对每个候选代码应用分类器进行筛选。理论优势在于将输出空间从完整词汇库缩小到更小的候选池。
AI.result: 在11,803个公开VSAC价值集上构建首个大规模基准。基于SAPBert微调的交叉编码器达到AUROC~0.852和价值集级F1~0.298，优于三层MLP(AUROC~0.799, F1~0.250)。两种方法都将每个真阳性的无关候选数从12.3(仅检索)分别降至约3.2和4.4。零样本GPT-4o的F1仅0.105，48.6%返回代码不在VSAC中。
AI.conclusion: RASC方法通过检索-选择策略有效解决了临床价值集构建问题，显著优于直接使用LLM的方法，且其优势随价值集规模增大而增强。该方法适用于多种分类器模型，具有广泛适用性。

title: StoryCoder: Narrative Reformulation for Structured Reasoning in LLM Code Generation
summary: Effective code generation requires both model capability and a problem representation that carefully structures how models reason and plan. Existing approaches augment reasoning steps or inject specific structure into how models think, but leave scattered problem conditions unchanged. Inspired by the way humans organize fragmented information into coherent explanations, we propose StoryCoder, a narrative reformulation framework that transforms code generation questions into coherent natural language narratives, providing richer contextual structure than simple rephrasings. Each narrative consists of three components: a task overview, constraints, and example test cases, guided by the selected algorithm and genre. Experiments across 11 models on HumanEval, LiveCodeBench, and CodeForces demonstrate consistent improvements, with an average gain of 18.7% in zero-shot pass@10. Beyond accuracy, our analyses reveal that narrative reformulation guides models toward correct algorithmic strategies, reduces implementation errors, and induces a more modular code structure. The analyses further show that these benefits depend on narrative coherence and genre alignment, suggesting that structured problem representation is important for code generation regardless of model scale or architecture. Our code is available at https://github.com/gu-ni/StoryCoder.

AI.tldr: StoryCoder框架将代码生成问题转化为连贯的自然语言叙事，通过任务概述、约束和测试用例三部分提供结构化问题表示，显著提升代码生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要关注增强推理步骤或注入特定结构，但忽略了分散的问题条件。受人类将碎片化信息组织成连贯解释的启发，需要一种能提供比简单重述更丰富上下文结构的问题表示方法。
AI.method: 提出StoryCoder叙事重构框架，将代码生成问题转化为由任务概述、约束和示例测试用例组成的自然语言叙事，并基于选定算法和体裁进行指导。
AI.result: 在HumanEval、LiveCodeBench和CodeForces上的11个模型实验中，平均零样本pass@10提升18.7%。叙事重构引导模型采用正确算法策略，减少实现错误，并产生更模块化的代码结构。
AI.conclusion: 结构化问题表示对代码生成至关重要，其效果取决于叙事连贯性和体裁对齐，且不受模型规模或架构影响。叙事重构能有效提升代码生成性能。

title: SynHAT: A Two-stage Coarse-to-Fine Diffusion Framework for Synthesizing Human Activity Traces
summary: Human activity traces (HATs) are critical for many applications, including human mobility modeling and point-of-interest (POI) recommendation. However, growing privacy concerns have severely limited access to authentic large-scale HAT datasets. Recent advances in generative AI provide new opportunities to synthesize realistic and privacy-preserving HATs for such applications. Yet two major challenges remain: (i) HATs are highly irregular and dynamic, with long and varying time intervals, making it difficult to capture their complex spatio-temporal dependencies and underlying distributions; and (ii) generative models are often computationally expensive, making long-term, fine-grained HAT synthesis inefficient. To address these challenges, we propose SynHAT, a computationally efficient coarse-to-fine HAT synthesis framework built on a novel spatio-temporal denoising diffusion model. In Stage 1, we develop Coarse-HADiff, which models the overall spatio-temporal dependencies of coarse-grained latent spatio-temporal traces. It incorporates a novel Latent Spatio-Temporal U-Net with dual Drift-Jitter branches to jointly model smooth spatial transitions and temporal variations during denoising. In Stage 2, we introduce a three-step pipeline consisting of Behavior Pattern Extraction, Fine-HADiff, which shares the same architecture as Coarse-HADiff, and Semantic Alignment to generate fine-grained latent spatio-temporal traces from the Stage 1 outputs. We extensively evaluate SynHAT in terms of data fidelity, utility, privacy, robustness, and scalability. Experiments on real-world HAT datasets from four cities across three countries show that SynHAT substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving 52% and 33% improvements on spatial and temporal metrics, respectively.

AI.tldr: SynHAT：一种基于时空去噪扩散模型的高效粗到细人类活动轨迹合成框架，用于生成真实且保护隐私的人类活动轨迹数据
AI.motivation: 人类活动轨迹对许多应用至关重要，但隐私问题严重限制了真实大规模数据集的访问。现有生成方法面临两大挑战：1）人类活动轨迹高度不规则且动态，具有长且变化的时间间隔，难以捕捉复杂的时空依赖关系；2）生成模型计算成本高，导致长期、细粒度合成效率低下。
AI.method: 提出SynHAT框架，包含两阶段：第一阶段使用Coarse-HADiff（基于潜在时空U-Net和双Drift-Jitter分支）建模粗粒度潜在时空轨迹的整体时空依赖；第二阶段通过行为模式提取、Fine-HADiff（与Coarse-HADiff相同架构）和语义对齐的三步流程，从第一阶段输出生成细粒度潜在时空轨迹。
AI.result: 在来自三个国家四个城市的真实人类活动轨迹数据集上评估，SynHAT在数据保真度、实用性、隐私性、鲁棒性和可扩展性方面显著优于现有基线方法，空间和时间指标分别提升52%和33%。
AI.conclusion: SynHAT通过创新的粗到细扩散模型框架，有效解决了人类活动轨迹合成中的时空依赖建模和计算效率问题，能够生成高质量、隐私保护的人类活动轨迹数据，为人类移动建模和POI推荐等应用提供支持。

title: Pushing the Boundaries of Multiple Choice Evaluation to One Hundred Options
summary: Multiple choice evaluation is widely used for benchmarking large language models, yet near ceiling accuracy in low option settings can be sustained by shortcut strategies that obscure true competence. Therefore, we propose a massive option evaluation protocol that scales the candidate set to one hundred options and sharply reduces the impact of chance performance. We apply this framework to a Korean orthography error detection task where models must pick the single incorrect sentence from a large candidate set. With fixed targets and repeated resampling and shuffling, we obtain stable estimates while separating content driven failures from positional artifacts. Across experiments, results indicate that strong performance in low option settings can overstate model competence. This apparent advantage often weakens under dense interference at high $N$, revealing gaps that conventional benchmarks tend to obscure. We identify two failure modes, semantic confusion and position bias toward early options under uncertainty. To isolate the effect of context length, we run padding controlled and length matched tests, which suggest that the main bottleneck is candidate ranking rather than context length. Together, these findings support massive option evaluation as a general framework for stress testing model reliability under extreme distractor density, beyond what low option benchmarks can reveal.

AI.tldr: 大规模选项评估协议：通过将候选集扩展到100个选项来减少偶然性影响，揭示在低选项设置中被掩盖的模型能力缺陷
AI.motivation: 传统多选评估在低选项设置中接近天花板准确率可能通过捷径策略维持，掩盖了真实能力，需要更严格的评估框架来揭示模型在极端干扰密度下的可靠性
AI.method: 提出大规模选项评估协议，将候选集扩展到100个选项；应用于韩语正字法错误检测任务，模型需从大量候选中选出单个错误句子；采用固定目标和重复重采样、洗牌来获得稳定估计；进行填充控制和长度匹配测试以分离上下文长度影响
AI.result: 低选项设置中的强性能可能高估模型能力，在高N值密集干扰下优势减弱；识别出两种失败模式：语义混淆和不确定性下对早期选项的位置偏见；主要瓶颈是候选排序而非上下文长度
AI.conclusion: 大规模选项评估可作为通用框架，在极端干扰密度下压力测试模型可靠性，揭示传统低选项基准无法发现的缺陷

title: Fact4ac at the Financial Misinformation Detection Challenge Task: Reference-Free Financial Misinformation Detection via Fine-Tuning and Few-Shot Prompting of Large Language Models
summary: The proliferation of financial misinformation poses a severe threat to market stability and investor trust, misleading market behavior and creating critical information asymmetry. Detecting such misleading narratives is inherently challenging, particularly in real-world scenarios where external evidence or supplementary references for cross-verification are strictly unavailable. This paper presents our winning methodology for the "Reference-Free Financial Misinformation Detection" shared task. Built upon the recently proposed RFC-BENCH framework (Jiang et al. 2026), this task challenges models to determine the veracity of financial claims by relying solely on internal semantic understanding and contextual consistency, rather than external fact-checking. To address this formidable evaluation setup, we propose a comprehensive framework that capitalizes on the reasoning capabilities of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). Our approach systematically integrates in-context learning, specifically zero-shot and few-shot prompting strategies, with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to optimally align the models with the subtle linguistic cues of financial manipulation. Our proposed system demonstrated superior efficacy, successfully securing the first-place ranking on both official leaderboards. Specifically, we achieved an accuracy of 95.4% on the public test set and 96.3% on the private test set, highlighting the robustness of our method and contributing to the acceleration of context-aware misinformation detection in financial Natural Language Processing. Our models (14B and 32B) are available at https://huggingface.co/KaiNKaiho.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的参考无关金融虚假信息检测方法，在RFC-BENCH基准测试中取得了第一名，公开测试集准确率达95.4%，私有测试集达96.3%。
AI.motivation: 金融虚假信息泛滥严重威胁市场稳定和投资者信任，导致市场行为误导和信息不对称。现有检测方法在缺乏外部证据或参考资料的现实场景下面临巨大挑战，需要开发仅依赖内部语义理解和上下文一致性的检测技术。
AI.method: 提出综合框架，利用最先进大语言模型的推理能力，系统整合上下文学习（零样本和少样本提示策略）与参数高效微调（通过LoRA低秩适应），使模型能够捕捉金融操纵的微妙语言线索。
AI.result: 在"Reference-Free Financial Misinformation Detection"共享任务中，该方法在两个官方排行榜均获得第一名，公开测试集准确率95.4%，私有测试集准确率96.3%，证明了方法的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功展示了基于大语言模型的参考无关金融虚假信息检测的有效性，为金融自然语言处理中的上下文感知虚假信息检测提供了加速，相关模型已在HuggingFace平台开源。
