title: SGA-MCTS: Decoupling Planning from Execution via Training-Free Atomic Experience Retrieval
summary: LLM-powered systems require complex multi-step decision-making abilities to solve real-world tasks, yet current planning approaches face a trade-off between the high latency of inference-time search and the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning. To address this limitation, we introduce \textbf{SGA-MCTS}, a framework that casts LLM planning as non-parametric retrieval. Offline, we leverage Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explore the solution space and distill high-fidelity trajectories into State-Goal-Action (SGA) atoms. These atoms are de-lexicalized primitives that abstract concrete entities into symbolic slots, preserving reusable causal logic while discarding domain-specific noise. Online, a retrieval-augmented agent employs a hybrid symbolic-semantic mechanism to fetch relevant SGAs and re-ground them into the current context as soft reasoning hints. Empirical results on complex benchmarks demonstrate that this paradigm enables frozen, open-weights models to match the performance of SOTA systems (e.g., GPT-5) without task-specific fine-tuning. By effectively amortizing the heavy computational cost of search, SGA-MCTS achieves System 2 reasoning depth at System 1 inference speeds, rendering autonomous planning both scalable and real-time feasible.

AI.tldr: SGA-MCTS框架将LLM规划转化为非参数检索，通过离线MCTS搜索生成去词汇化的状态-目标-动作原子，在线检索并重定位到当前上下文，实现系统2推理深度与系统1推理速度的结合。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM规划方法面临推理时搜索的高延迟与监督微调的有限泛化能力之间的权衡，需要一种既能保持深度推理能力又能实现实时推理的解决方案。
AI.method: 离线阶段使用蒙特卡洛树搜索探索解空间，将高质量轨迹蒸馏为状态-目标-动作原子，这些原子将具体实体抽象为符号槽；在线阶段通过混合符号-语义机制检索相关SGA原子，并将其重定位到当前上下文作为软推理提示。
AI.result: 在复杂基准测试中，该框架使冻结的开放权重模型能够匹配最先进系统（如GPT-5）的性能，而无需任务特定微调，实现了系统2推理深度与系统1推理速度的结合。
AI.conclusion: SGA-MCTS通过将搜索计算成本分摊到离线阶段，实现了自主规划的可扩展性和实时可行性，为LLM-powered系统提供了高效的复杂决策能力。

title: CURaTE: Continual Unlearning in Real Time with Ensured Preservation of LLM Knowledge
summary: The inability to filter out in advance all potentially problematic data from the pre-training of large language models has given rise to the need for methods for unlearning specific pieces of knowledge after training. Existing techniques overlook the need for continuous and immediate action, causing them to suffer from degraded utility as updates accumulate and protracted exposure of sensitive information. To address these issues, we propose Continual Unlearning in Real Time with Ensured Preservation of LLM Knowledge (CURaTE). Our method begins by training a sentence embedding model on a dataset designed to enable the formation of sharp decision boundaries for determining whether a given input prompt corresponds to any stored forget requests. The similarity of a given input to the forget requests is then used to determine whether to answer or return a refusal response. We show that even with such a simple approach, not only does CURaTE achieve more effective forgetting than existing methods, but by avoiding modification of the language model parameters, it also maintains near perfect knowledge preservation over any number of updates and is the only method capable of continual unlearning in real-time.

AI.tldr: CURaTE是一种实时持续遗忘方法，通过训练句子嵌入模型来识别遗忘请求，避免修改LLM参数，实现高效遗忘和知识保护
AI.motivation: 现有遗忘方法无法满足持续实时需求，导致效用下降和敏感信息长期暴露，需要一种能即时响应遗忘请求且不损害模型知识的方法
AI.method: 训练句子嵌入模型在专门数据集上形成清晰决策边界，通过计算输入提示与遗忘请求的相似度来决定是否回答或拒绝响应，避免修改语言模型参数
AI.result: CURaTE比现有方法遗忘效果更好，通过避免参数修改保持近乎完美的知识保护，是唯一能实现实时持续遗忘的方法
AI.conclusion: CURaTE提供了一种简单有效的实时持续遗忘解决方案，通过外部决策机制实现遗忘而不损害模型知识，为大语言模型的知识管理提供了新思路

title: CURA: Clinical Uncertainty Risk Alignment for Language Model-Based Risk Prediction
summary: Clinical language models (LMs) are increasingly applied to support clinical risk prediction from free-text notes, yet their uncertainty estimates often remain poorly calibrated and clinically unreliable. In this work, we propose Clinical Uncertainty Risk Alignment (CURA), a framework that aligns clinical LM-based risk estimates and uncertainty with both individual error likelihoods and cohort-level ambiguities. CURA first fine-tunes domain-specific clinical LMs to obtain task-adapted patient embeddings, and then performs uncertainty fine-tuning of a multi-head classifier using a bi-level uncertainty objective. Specifically, an individual-level calibration term aligns predictive uncertainty with each patient's likelihood of error, while a cohort-aware regularizer pulls risk estimates toward event rates in their local neighborhoods in the embedding space and places extra weight on ambiguous cohorts near the decision boundary. We further show that this cohort-aware term can be interpreted as a cross-entropy loss with neighborhood-informed soft labels, providing a label-smoothing view of our method. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-IV clinical risk prediction tasks across various clinical LMs show that CURA consistently improves calibration metrics without substantially compromising discrimination. Further analysis illustrates that CURA reduces overconfident false reassurance and yields more trustworthy uncertainty estimates for downstream clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: CURA框架通过双层不确定性目标校准临床语言模型的风险估计和不确定性，同时考虑个体错误可能性和群体模糊性，提升临床决策支持的可信度。
AI.motivation: 临床语言模型在自由文本笔记的风险预测中应用日益广泛，但其不确定性估计通常校准不佳且临床不可靠，需要改进以提供更可信的临床决策支持。
AI.method: CURA框架首先微调领域特定的临床语言模型获取任务适应的患者嵌入，然后使用双层不确定性目标微调多头分类器：个体级校准项使预测不确定性与患者错误可能性对齐，群体感知正则化器将风险估计拉向嵌入空间中局部邻域的事件率，并对决策边界附近的模糊群体赋予额外权重。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV临床风险预测任务上的广泛实验表明，CURA在各种临床语言模型中一致改善了校准指标，且未显著损害判别能力。进一步分析显示CURA减少了过度自信的虚假保证，为下游临床决策支持提供了更可信的不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: CURA框架通过同时对齐个体错误可能性和群体模糊性，有效校准临床语言模型的风险估计和不确定性，提高了临床决策支持系统的可靠性和可信度。

title: The Agentification of Scientific Research: A Physicist's Perspective
summary: This article argues that the most important significance of the AI revolution, especially the rise of large language models, lies not simply in automation, but in a fundamental change in how complex information and human know-how are carried, replicated, and shared. From this perspective, AI for Science is especially important because it may transform not only the efficiency of research, but also the structure of scientific collaboration, discovery, publishing, and evaluation. The article outlines a gradual path from AI as a research tool to AI as a scientific collaborator, and discusses how AI is likely to fundamentally reshape scientific publication. It also argues that continuous learning and diversity of ideas are essential if AI is to play a meaningful role in original scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: AI革命的核心意义在于改变复杂信息和人类知识的承载、复制与共享方式，而AI for Science将不仅提升科研效率，更会重塑科学协作、发现、出版和评估的结构。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在探讨AI革命（特别是大语言模型）的真正意义，强调其不仅在于自动化，更在于根本性地改变复杂信息和人类知识的传播方式。作者特别关注AI for Science领域，认为它将深刻影响科学研究的多方面结构。
AI.method: 文章采用理论分析和框架构建的方法，首先提出AI革命的核心意义在于知识传播方式的变革，然后专门针对AI for Science领域，勾勒出从AI作为研究工具到科学协作者的渐进路径，并讨论AI如何重塑科学出版体系。
AI.result: 文章提出了AI革命的核心意义在于知识传播方式的根本变革，并针对AI for Science领域，系统阐述了AI将如何从工具演变为协作者，以及这将如何重塑科学协作、发现、出版和评估的整个生态系统。
AI.conclusion: 要使AI在原创性科学发现中发挥有意义的作用，持续学习和思想多样性至关重要。AI for Science不仅会提高科研效率，更将从根本上改变科学知识的生产、传播和评估方式，重塑整个科学研究生态系统。

title: SPAGBias: Uncovering and Tracing Structured Spatial Gender Bias in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are being increasingly used in urban planning, but since gendered space theory highlights how gender hierarchies are embedded in spatial organization, there is concern that LLMs may reproduce or amplify such biases. We introduce SPAGBias - the first systematic framework to evaluate spatial gender bias in LLMs. It combines a taxonomy of 62 urban micro-spaces, a prompt library, and three diagnostic layers: explicit (forced-choice resampling), probabilistic (token-level asymmetry), and constructional (semantic and narrative role analysis). Testing six representative models, we identify structured gender-space associations that go beyond the public-private divide, forming nuanced micro-level mappings. Story generation reveals how emotion, wording, and social roles jointly shape "spatial gender narratives". We also examine how prompt design, temperature, and model scale influence bias expression. Tracing experiments indicate that these patterns are embedded and reinforced across the model pipeline (pre-training, instruction tuning, and reward modeling), with model associations found to substantially exceed real-world distributions. Downstream experiments further reveal that such biases produce concrete failures in both normative and descriptive application settings. This work connects sociological theory with computational analysis, extending bias research into the spatial domain and uncovering how LLMs encode social gender cognition through language.

AI.tldr: SPAGBias框架首次系统评估LLMs中的空间性别偏见，通过62种城市微空间分类、提示库和三层诊断方法，发现LLMs存在超越公私领域划分的结构化性别-空间关联，这些偏见在模型训练全流程中被嵌入和强化。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs在城市规划中应用增加，基于性别空间理论（性别等级制嵌入空间组织）的担忧，需要系统评估LLMs是否再现或放大空间性别偏见，连接社会学理论与计算分析。
AI.method: 提出SPAGBias框架：1) 62种城市微空间分类法；2) 提示库；3) 三层诊断：显性（强制选择重采样）、概率性（词元级不对称性）、建构性（语义和叙事角色分析）。测试六个代表性模型，考察提示设计、温度和模型规模对偏见表达的影响。
AI.result: 发现结构化性别-空间关联超越公私领域划分，形成细粒度映射；故事生成揭示情感、措辞和社会角色共同塑造"空间性别叙事"；模型关联显著超出真实世界分布；下游实验显示偏见在规范性和描述性应用场景中产生具体失败。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将社会学理论与计算分析结合，将偏见研究扩展到空间领域，揭示LLMs如何通过语言编码社会性别认知，为评估和缓解空间性别偏见提供系统框架。

title: Personalized and Context-Aware Transformer Models for Predicting Post-Intervention Physiological Responses from Wearable Sensor Data
summary: Consumer wearables enable continuous measurement of physiological data related to stress and recovery, but turning these streams into actionable, personalized stress-management recommendations remains a challenge. In practice, users often do not know how a given intervention, defined as an activity intended to reduce stress, will affect heart rate (HR), heart rate variability (HRV), or inter-beat intervals (BBI) over the next 15 to 120 minutes. We present a framework that predicts post-intervention trajectories and the direction of change for these physiological indicators across time windows. Our methodology combines a Transformer model for multi-horizon trajectories of percent change relative to a pre-intervention baseline, direction-of-change calls (positive, negative, or neutral) at each horizon, and an empirical study using wearable sensor data overlaid with user-tagged events and interventions. This proof of concept shows that personalized post-intervention prediction is feasible. We encourage future integration into stress-management tools for personalized intervention recommendations tailored to each person's day following further validation in larger studies and, where applicable, appropriate regulatory review.

AI.tldr: 开发了一个基于Transformer的框架，用于预测个性化干预后生理指标（心率、心率变异性等）的变化轨迹和方向，为可穿戴设备提供个性化压力管理建议
AI.motivation: 消费者可穿戴设备能够连续测量与压力和恢复相关的生理数据，但将这些数据流转化为可操作的个性化压力管理建议仍然是一个挑战。用户通常不知道特定干预措施（旨在减轻压力的活动）会如何影响未来15-120分钟的心率、心率变异性或心跳间隔
AI.method: 结合Transformer模型预测相对于干预前基线的多时间窗口百分比变化轨迹，在每个时间窗口进行变化方向判断（正向、负向或中性），并使用可穿戴传感器数据叠加用户标记的事件和干预进行实证研究
AI.result: 概念验证表明，个性化干预后预测是可行的。该框架能够预测干预后生理指标的轨迹和变化方向
AI.conclusion: 鼓励未来将该框架整合到压力管理工具中，为每个人的日常提供个性化干预建议，但需要在更大规模的研究中进行进一步验证，并在适用时进行适当的监管审查

title: Which bird does not have wings: Negative-constrained KGQA with Schema-guided Semantic Matching and Self-directed Refinement
summary: Large language models still struggle with faithfulness and hallucinations despite their remarkable reasoning abilities. In Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA), semantic parsing-based approaches address the limitations by understanding constraints in a user's question and converting them into a logical form to execute on a knowledge graph. However, existing KGQA benchmarks and methods are biased toward positive and calculation constraints. Negative constraints are neglected, although they frequently appear in real-world questions. In this paper, we introduce a new task, NEgative-conSTrained (NEST) KGQA, where each question contains at least one negative constraint, and a corresponding dataset, NestKGQA. We also design PyLF, a Python-formatted logical form, since existing logical forms are hardly suitable to express negation clearly while maintaining readability. Furthermore, NEST questions naturally contain multiple constraints. To mitigate their semantic complexity, we present a novel framework named CUCKOO, specialized to multiple-constrained questions and ensuring semantic executability. CUCKOO first generates a constraint-aware logical form draft and performs schema-guided semantic matching. It then selectively applies self-directed refinement only when executing improper logical forms yields an empty result, reducing cost while improving robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that CUCKOO consistently outperforms baselines on both conventional KGQA and NEST-KGQA benchmarks under few-shot settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对知识图谱问答中负约束被忽视的问题，提出了NEST-KGQA任务和数据集，设计了PyLF逻辑形式，并开发了CUCKOO框架来处理多约束问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在忠实度和幻觉方面仍有不足。现有KGQA基准和方法偏向正约束和计算约束，忽视了负约束，而负约束在实际问题中频繁出现。
AI.method: 1) 提出NEST-KGQA任务和NestKGQA数据集；2) 设计Python格式的逻辑形式PyLF以清晰表达否定；3) 开发CUCKOO框架，首先生成约束感知的逻辑形式草稿，进行模式引导的语义匹配，然后仅在执行不当逻辑形式产生空结果时选择性应用自导向精炼。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CUCKOO在少样本设置下，在传统KGQA和NEST-KGQA基准测试中均持续优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了KGQA中负约束处理的空白，提出的NEST-KGQA任务、PyLF逻辑形式和CUCKOO框架为处理多约束问题提供了有效解决方案，提高了KGQA系统的鲁棒性和实用性。

title: Disentangle-then-Refine: LLM-Guided Decoupling and Structure-Aware Refinement for Graph Contrastive Learning
summary: Conventional Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) on Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs) relies on blind stochastic augmentations, inadvertently entangling task-relevant signals with noise. We propose SDM-SCR, a robust framework anchored in Approximate Orthogonal Decomposition. First, the Semantic Decoupling Module (SDM) leverages the instruction-following capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to actively parse raw attributes into asymmetric, task-oriented signal and noise views. This shifts the paradigm from random perturbation to semantic-aware disentanglement. Subsequently, Semantic Consistency Regularization (SCR) exploits the spectral observation that semantic signals are topologically smooth while residual noise is high-frequency. SCR functions as a selective spectral filter, enforcing consistency only on the signal subspace to eliminate LLM hallucinations without over-smoothing. This ``Disentangle-then-Refine'' mechanism ensures rigorous signal purification. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SDM-SCR achieves SOTA performance in accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: SDM-SCR是一种基于近似正交分解的图对比学习框架，通过LLM语义解耦和谱一致性正则化，在文本属性图上实现任务相关信号与噪声的分离，提升学习效果。
AI.motivation: 传统文本属性图上的图对比学习依赖随机增强，无意中将任务相关信号与噪声纠缠在一起，影响了学习效果。需要一种能够主动分离信号与噪声的方法。
AI.method: 提出SDM-SCR框架：1) 语义解耦模块(SDM)利用LLM的指令跟随能力，将原始属性解析为不对称的任务导向信号视图和噪声视图；2) 语义一致性正则化(SCR)基于谱观察（语义信号拓扑平滑而残差噪声高频），作为选择性谱滤波器，仅在信号子空间上强制一致性以消除LLM幻觉。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SDM-SCR在准确性和效率方面均达到最先进的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: SDM-SCR通过"先解耦再精炼"机制实现了严格的信号净化，将图对比学习范式从随机扰动转变为语义感知的解缠结，显著提升了文本属性图上的学习效果。

title: CoPA: Benchmarking Personalized Question Answering with Data-Informed Cognitive Factors
summary: While LLMs have demonstrated remarkable potential in Question Answering (QA), evaluating personalization remains a critical bottleneck. Existing paradigms predominantly rely on lexical-level similarity or manual heuristics, often lacking sufficient data-driven validation. We address this by mining Community-Individual Preference Divergence (CIPD), where individual choices override consensus, to distill six key personalization factors as evaluative dimensions. Accordingly, we introduce CoPA, a benchmark with 1,985 user profiles for fine-grained, factor-level assessment. By quantifying the alignment between model outputs and user-specific cognitive preferences inferred from interaction patterns, CoPA provides a more comprehensive and discriminative standard for evaluating personalized QA than generic metrics. The code is available at https://github.com/bjzgcai/CoPA.

AI.tldr: CoPA是一个用于评估个性化问答的基准，通过挖掘社区-个体偏好分歧来定义六个个性化因素，包含1,985个用户配置文件，提供细粒度的因子级评估。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在问答任务中表现出巨大潜力，但评估个性化能力仍存在关键瓶颈。现有方法主要依赖词汇级相似性或手动启发式规则，缺乏充分的数据驱动验证。
AI.method: 通过挖掘社区-个体偏好分歧（CIPD）来提取六个关键个性化因素作为评估维度，构建CoPA基准，包含1,985个用户配置文件，通过量化模型输出与用户特定认知偏好的对齐程度进行评估。
AI.result: CoPA提供了一个比通用指标更全面和更具区分性的个性化问答评估标准，能够量化模型输出与用户特定认知偏好的对齐程度。
AI.conclusion: CoPA通过数据驱动的方法解决了个性化问答评估的瓶颈问题，为评估LLM的个性化能力提供了更全面和具有区分性的基准。

title: CoTEvol: Self-Evolving Chain-of-Thoughts for Data Synthesis in Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong mathematical reasoning when trained on high-quality Chain-of-Thought (CoT) that articulates intermediate steps, yet costly CoT curation hinders further progress. While existing remedies such as distillation from stronger LLMs and self-synthesis based on test-time search alleviate this issue, they often suffer from diminishing returns or high computing overhead.In this work, we propose CoTEvol, a genetic evolutionary framework that casts CoT generation as a population-based search over reasoning trajectories.Candidate trajectories are iteratively evolved through reflective global crossover at the trajectory level and local mutation guided by uncertainty at the step level, enabling holistic recombination and fine-grained refinement. Lightweight, task-aware fitness functions are designed to guide the evolutionary process toward accurate and diverse reasoning. Empirically, CoTEvol improves correct-CoT synthesis success by over 30% and enhances structural diversity, with markedly improved efficiency. LLMs trained on these evolutionary CoT data achieve an average gain of 6.6% across eight math benchmarks, outperforming previous distillation and self-synthesis approaches. These results underscore the promise of evolutionary CoT synthesis as a scalable and effective method for mathematical reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: CoTEvol：一种基于遗传进化的框架，用于生成高质量、多样化的思维链（CoT），以提升LLM的数学推理能力，相比现有方法在效果和效率上均有显著改进。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如从更强LLM蒸馏或基于测试时搜索的自合成）存在收益递减或计算开销大的问题，高质量CoT标注成本高昂阻碍了LLM数学推理能力的进一步提升。
AI.method: 提出CoTEvol遗传进化框架，将CoT生成视为基于种群的推理轨迹搜索。通过轨迹级的全局交叉和步骤级的不确定性引导局部变异迭代进化候选轨迹，并设计轻量级任务感知适应度函数引导进化过程。
AI.result: CoTEvol将正确CoT合成成功率提升30%以上，增强结构多样性且效率显著提升。基于进化CoT数据训练的LLM在八个数学基准上平均提升6.6%，优于先前蒸馏和自合成方法。
AI.conclusion: 进化CoT合成是一种可扩展且有效的数学推理方法，为高质量CoT生成提供了新思路，有望推动LLM数学推理能力的进一步发展。

title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Evaluating Abstention in Multimodal Reasoning Systems
summary: Effective abstention (EA), recognizing evidence insufficiency and refraining from answering, is critical for reliable multimodal systems. Yet existing evaluation paradigms for vision-language models (VLMs) and multi-agent systems (MAS) assume answerability, pushing models to always respond. Abstention has been studied in text-only settings but remains underexplored multimodally; current benchmarks either ignore unanswerability or rely on coarse methods that miss realistic failure modes. We introduce MM-AQA, a benchmark that constructs unanswerable instances from answerable ones via transformations along two axes: visual modality dependency and evidence sufficiency. Evaluating three frontier VLMs spanning closed and open-source models and two MAS architectures across 2079 samples, we find: (1) under standard prompting, VLMs rarely abstain; even simple confidence baselines outperform this setup, (2) MAS improves abstention but introduces an accuracy-abstention trade-off, (3) sequential designs match or exceed iterative variants, suggesting the bottleneck is miscalibration rather than reasoning depth, and (4) models abstain when image or text evidence is absent, but attempt reconciliation with degraded or contradictory evidence. Effective multimodal abstention requires abstention-aware training rather than better prompting or more agents.

AI.tldr: MM-AQA是一个新的多模态基准测试，通过视觉模态依赖性和证据充分性两个维度构建不可回答实例，评估视觉语言模型和多智能体系统的有效弃权能力，发现现有模型很少主动弃权，需要弃权感知训练而非更好的提示或更多智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型和多智能体系统的评估范式假设所有问题都是可回答的，迫使模型总是给出回答，而忽略了证据不足时有效弃权的重要性。多模态环境下的弃权研究不足，现有基准要么忽略不可回答性，要么使用粗糙方法无法捕捉现实失败模式。
AI.method: 提出MM-AQA基准，通过两个轴构建不可回答实例：视觉模态依赖性（图像是否提供必要信息）和证据充分性（证据是否足够）。从可回答实例通过变换生成不可回答实例。评估了三个前沿视觉语言模型（包括闭源和开源模型）和两种多智能体架构，共2079个样本。
AI.result: 1) 标准提示下，视觉语言模型很少弃权；简单的置信度基线优于此设置。2) 多智能体系统改善弃权但引入准确率-弃权权衡。3) 顺序设计匹配或优于迭代变体，表明瓶颈是校准错误而非推理深度。4) 模型在图像或文本证据缺失时弃权，但在证据降级或矛盾时尝试调和。
AI.conclusion: 有效的多模态弃权需要弃权感知训练，而非更好的提示或更多智能体。当前模型在证据不足时缺乏可靠弃权能力，需要专门训练来改善这一关键可靠性特征。

title: MirrorBench: Evaluating Self-centric Intelligence in MLLMs by Introducing a Mirror
summary: Recent progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has demonstrated remarkable advances in perception and reasoning, suggesting their potential for embodied intelligence. While recent studies have evaluated embodied MLLMs in interactive settings, current benchmarks mainly target capabilities to perceive, understand, and interact with external objects, lacking a systematic evaluation of self-centric intelligence. To address this, we introduce MirrorBench, a simulation-based benchmark inspired by the classical Mirror Self-Recognition (MSR) test in psychology. MirrorBench extends this paradigm to embodied MLLMs through a tiered framework of progressively challenging tasks, assessing agents from basic visual perception to high-level self-representation. Experiments on leading MLLMs show that even at the lowest level, their performance remains substantially inferior to human performance, revealing fundamental limitations in self-referential understanding. Our study bridges psychological paradigms and embodied intelligence, offering a principled framework for evaluating the emergence of general intelligence in large models. Project page: https://fflahm.github.io/mirror-bench-page/.

AI.tldr: MirrorBench：基于心理学镜像自我识别测试的仿真基准，用于系统评估具身MLLMs的自我中心智能，揭示当前模型在自我参照理解方面的根本局限性。
AI.motivation: 当前具身MLLMs的评估基准主要关注对外部物体的感知、理解和交互能力，缺乏对自我中心智能的系统性评估。心理学中的镜像自我识别测试为评估自我认知提供了经典范式。
AI.method: 提出MirrorBench基准，将心理学镜像自我识别范式扩展到具身MLLMs，采用分层框架设计渐进式挑战任务，从基础视觉感知到高级自我表征进行系统评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使在最低难度级别，领先MLLMs的表现也显著低于人类水平，揭示了模型在自我参照理解方面的根本局限性。
AI.conclusion: MirrorBench将心理学范式与具身智能相结合，为评估大模型中通用智能的出现提供了原则性框架，揭示了当前MLLMs在自我认知方面的不足。

title: Modeling LLM Unlearning as an Asymmetric Two-Task Learning Problem
summary: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) aims to remove targeted knowledge while preserving general capability. In this paper, we recast LLM unlearning as an asymmetric two-task problem: retention is the primary objective and forgetting is an auxiliary. From this perspective, we propose a retention-prioritized gradient synthesis framework that decouples task-specific gradient extraction from conflict-aware combination. Instantiating the framework, we adapt established PCGrad to resolve gradient conflicts, and introduce SAGO, a novel retention-prioritized gradient synthesis method. Theoretically, both variants ensure non-negative cosine similarity with the retain gradient, while SAGO achieves strictly tighter alignment through constructive sign-constrained synthesis. Empirically, on WMDP Bio/Cyber and RWKU benchmarks, SAGO consistently pushes the Pareto frontier: e.g., on WMDP Bio (SimNPO+GD), recovery of target model MMLU performance progresses from 44.6% (naive) to 94.0% (+PCGrad) and further to 96.0% (+SAGO), while maintaining comparable forgetting strength. Our results show that re-shaping gradient geometry, rather than re-balancing losses, is the key to mitigating unlearning-retention trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 提出保留优先的梯度合成框架SAGO，将LLM遗忘重构为不对称双任务问题，通过解耦梯度提取与冲突感知组合来缓解遗忘-保留权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法在移除目标知识时难以平衡遗忘与保留的权衡，通常导致模型通用能力下降。需要一种能优先保证保留性能同时有效遗忘的方法。
AI.method: 将LLM遗忘重构为不对称双任务问题：保留是主要目标，遗忘是辅助任务。提出保留优先的梯度合成框架，包含任务特定梯度提取和冲突感知组合两个阶段。具体实现包括：1) 基于PCGrad的梯度冲突解决；2) 提出SAGO方法，通过构造性符号约束合成确保与保留梯度的严格对齐。
AI.result: 在WMDP Bio/Cyber和RWKU基准测试中，SAGO持续推动Pareto前沿。例如在WMDP Bio（SimNPO+GD）上，目标模型MMLU性能恢复从44.6%（朴素方法）提升到94.0%（+PCGrad），进一步达到96.0%（+SAGO），同时保持相当的遗忘强度。理论证明两种变体都能确保与保留梯度的非负余弦相似度，而SAGO通过构造性符号约束合成实现更严格的对齐。
AI.conclusion: 重塑梯度几何而非重新平衡损失是缓解遗忘-保留权衡的关键。保留优先的梯度合成框架通过解耦任务特定梯度提取和冲突感知组合，有效解决了LLM遗忘中的性能权衡问题。

title: CogEvolution: A Human-like Generative Educational Agent to Simulate Student's Cognitive Evolution
summary: Generative Agents, owing to their precise modeling and simulation capabilities of human behavior, have become a pivotal tool in the field of Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIEd) for uncovering complex cognitive processes of learners. However, existing educational agents predominantly rely on static personas to simulate student learning behaviors, neglecting the decisive role of deep cognitive capabilities in learning outcomes during practice interactions. Furthermore, they struggle to characterize the dynamic fluidity of knowledge internalization, transfer, and cognitive state transitions. To overcome this bottleneck, this paper proposes a human-like educational agent capable of simulating student cognitive evolution: CogEvolution. Specifically, we first construct a cognitive depth perceptron based on the Interactive, Constructive, Active, Passive (ICAP) taxonomy from cognitive psychology, achieving precise quantification of learner cognitive engagement. Subsequently, we propose a memory retrieval method based on Item Response Theory (IRT) to simulate the connection and assimilation of new and prior knowledge. Finally, we design a dynamic cognitive update mechanism based on evolutionary algorithms to simulate the real-time integration of student learning behaviors and cognitive evolution processes. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that CogEvolution not only significantly outperforms baseline models in behavioral fidelity and learning curve fitting but also uniquely reproduces plausible and robust cognitive evolutionary paths consistent with educational psychology expectations, providing a novel paradigm for constructing highly interpretable educational agents.

AI.tldr: 提出CogEvolution：一种能够模拟学生认知演化的人类化教育智能体，通过认知深度感知器、基于IRT的记忆检索和动态认知更新机制，克服现有教育智能体静态角色和认知建模不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有教育智能体主要依赖静态角色模拟学生学习行为，忽视了深度认知能力在学习结果中的决定性作用，且难以刻画知识内化、迁移和认知状态转换的动态流动性。需要构建能够模拟学生认知演化的智能体来突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 1. 基于认知心理学ICAP分类构建认知深度感知器，实现学习者认知参与的精确量化；2. 提出基于项目反应理论(IRT)的记忆检索方法，模拟新旧知识的连接与同化；3. 设计基于进化算法的动态认知更新机制，模拟学生学习行为与认知演化过程的实时整合。
AI.result: 综合评估表明，CogEvolution在行为保真度和学习曲线拟合方面显著优于基线模型，并能独特地复现符合教育心理学预期的合理且稳健的认知演化路径，为构建高可解释性教育智能体提供了新范式。
AI.conclusion: CogEvolution通过模拟学生认知演化，解决了现有教育智能体在深度认知建模和动态知识内化方面的局限性，为AIEd领域提供了能够揭示复杂认知过程的新型智能体架构。

title: Domain Fine-Tuning FinBERT on Finnish Histopathological Reports: Train-Time Signals and Downstream Correlations
summary:
In NLP classification tasks where little labeled data exists, domain fine-tuning of transformer models on unlabeled data is an established approach. In this paper we have two aims.
  (1) We describe our observations from fine-tuning the Finnish BERT model on Finnish medical text data.
  (2) We report on our attempts to predict the benefit of domain-specific pre-training of Finnish BERT from observing the geometry of embedding changes due to domain fine-tuning.
  Our driving motivation is the common\situation in healthcare AI where we might experience long delays in acquiring datasets, especially with respect to labels.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了在芬兰语医疗文本上对芬兰语BERT模型进行领域微调的效果，并尝试通过观察嵌入几何变化来预测领域特定预训练的收益。
AI.motivation: 在医疗AI领域，获取标注数据通常存在长时间延迟，特别是在标签获取方面。研究旨在解决NLP分类任务中标注数据稀缺的问题，通过领域微调来提升模型性能。
AI.method: 1) 在芬兰语医疗文本数据上对芬兰语BERT模型进行领域微调；2) 通过观察领域微调引起的嵌入几何变化，尝试预测领域特定预训练的收益。
AI.result: 论文描述了在芬兰语医疗文本上微调芬兰语BERT的观察结果，并报告了通过嵌入几何变化预测领域预训练收益的尝试。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为医疗AI领域处理标注数据稀缺问题提供了实用方法，通过领域微调和嵌入几何分析来优化模型性能，特别是在芬兰语医疗文本处理方面。

title: Sequence Search: Automated Sequence Design using Neural Architecture Search
summary: Developing an MR sequence is challenging and remains largely constrained by human intuition. Recently, AI-driven approaches have been proposed; however, most require an initial sequence for parameter optimization or extensive training datasets, limiting their general applicability. In this study, we propose "Sequence Search," an automated sequence design framework based on neural architecture search. The method takes tissue properties, imaging parameters, and design objectives as inputs and generates pulse sequences satisfying the design objectives, without requiring prior knowledge of conventional sequence structures. Sequence Search iteratively generates candidate sequences through neural architecture search and optimizes them via a differentiable Bloch simulator and objective-specific loss functions using gradient-based learning. The framework successfully replicated conventional spin-echo, T2-weighted spin-echo, and inversion recovery sequences. Less intuitive solutions were also discovered, such as three-RF spin-echo-like sequences with reduced RF energy and refocusing phases deviating from the conventional Hahn-echo. This work establishes a generalizable framework for automated MR sequence design, highlighting the potential to explore configurations beyond conventional designs based on human intuition.

AI.tldr: 提出基于神经架构搜索的自动化MR序列设计框架"Sequence Search"，无需初始序列或大量训练数据，可直接从组织特性、成像参数和设计目标生成满足要求的脉冲序列。
AI.motivation: 传统MR序列开发依赖人类直觉，现有AI方法需要初始序列进行参数优化或大量训练数据，限制了通用性。需要一种无需先验知识、能自动设计MR序列的通用框架。
AI.method: 基于神经架构搜索的自动化序列设计框架：输入组织特性、成像参数和设计目标；通过神经架构搜索迭代生成候选序列；使用可微分Bloch模拟器和基于梯度的学习，通过目标特定损失函数优化序列。
AI.result: 成功复现了传统自旋回波、T2加权自旋回波和反转恢复序列；发现了非直觉的解决方案，如三射频自旋回波样序列（降低射频能量）和偏离传统Hahn回波的重聚焦相位序列。
AI.conclusion: 建立了可通用的自动化MR序列设计框架，展示了探索超越传统基于人类直觉设计的配置潜力，为MR序列开发提供了新范式。

title: Exploring and Testing Skill-Based Behavioral Profile Annotation: Human Operability and LLM Feasibility under Schema-Guided Execution
summary: Behavioral Profile (BP) annotation is difficult to automate because it requires simultaneous coding across multiple linguistic dimensions. We treat BP annotation as a bundle of annotation skills rather than a single task and evaluate LLM-assisted BP annotation from this perspective. Using 3,134 concordance lines of 30 Chinese metaphorical color-term derivatives and a 14-feature BP schema, we implement a skill-file-driven pipeline in which each feature is externally defined through schema files, decision rules, and examples. Two human annotators completed a two-round schema-only protocol on a 300-instance validation subset, enabling BP skills to be classified as directly operable, recoverable under focused re-annotation, or structurally underspecified. GPT-5.4 and three locally deployable open-source models were then evaluated under the same setup. Results show that BP annotation is highly heterogeneous at the skill level: 5 skills are directly operable, 4 are recoverable after focused re-annotation, and 5 remain structurally underspecified. GPT-5.4 executes the retained skills with substantial reliability (accuracy = 0.678, \k{appa} = 0.665, weighted F1 = 0.695), but this feasibility is selective rather than global. Human and GPT difficulty profiles are strongly aligned at the skill level (r = 0.881), but not at the instance level (r = 0.016) or lexical-item level (r = -0.142), a pattern we describe as shared taxonomy, independent execution. Pairwise agreement further suggests that GPT is better understood as an independent third skill voice than as a direct human substitute. Open-source failures are concentrated in schema-to-skill execution problems. These findings suggest that automatic annotation should be evaluated in terms of skill feasibility rather than task-level automation.

AI.tldr: 该研究将行为特征标注视为多项技能的组合而非单一任务，通过技能文件驱动的流程评估LLM辅助标注，发现GPT-5.4在可执行技能上表现可靠，但可行性具有选择性而非全局性。
AI.motivation: 行为特征标注难以自动化，因为它需要在多个语言维度上同时编码。研究者将其视为一组标注技能而非单一任务，从这一角度评估LLM辅助的行为特征标注。
AI.method: 使用3,134条中文隐喻色彩词衍生词的语料和14个特征的标注体系，实施技能文件驱动的标注流程：每个特征通过模式文件、决策规则和示例外部定义。两名人工标注者在300条验证子集上完成两轮标注，将技能分类为可直接操作、可通过聚焦重标注恢复、或结构未指定。然后在相同设置下评估GPT-5.4和三个本地可部署的开源模型。
AI.result: 行为特征标注在技能层面高度异质：5项技能可直接操作，4项可通过聚焦重标注恢复，5项保持结构未指定。GPT-5.4执行保留技能具有实质性可靠性（准确率=0.678，κ=0.665，加权F1=0.695），但可行性是选择性的而非全局性的。人类和GPT的困难分布在技能层面高度一致（r=0.881），但在实例层面（r=0.016）和词汇项目层面（r=-0.142）不一致，呈现"共享分类体系，独立执行"模式。成对一致性进一步表明GPT应被视为独立的第三技能声音而非直接的人类替代品。开源模型的失败主要集中在模式到技能的执行问题上。
AI.conclusion: 自动标注应基于技能可行性而非任务级自动化进行评估。GPT-5.4在行为特征标注中表现出选择性可行性，更适合作为独立的标注声音而非人类替代品。技能层面的评估方法比整体任务评估更能揭示自动标注的实际能力。

title: Beyond Literal Summarization: Redefining Hallucination for Medical SOAP Note Evaluation
summary:
Evaluating large language models (LLMs) for clinical documentation tasks such as SOAP note generation remains challenging. Unlike standard summarization, these tasks require clinical abstraction, normalization of colloquial language, and medically grounded inference. However, prevailing evaluation methods including automated metrics and LLM as judge frameworks rely on lexical faithfulness, often labeling any information not explicitly present in the transcript as hallucination.
  We show that such approaches systematically misclassify clinically valid outputs as errors, inflating hallucination rates and distorting model assessment. Our analysis reveals that many flagged hallucinations correspond to legitimate clinical transformations, including synonym mapping, abstraction of examination findings, diagnostic inference, and guideline consistent care planning.
  By aligning evaluation criteria with clinical reasoning through calibrated prompting and retrieval grounded in medical ontologies we observe a significant shift in outcomes. Under a lexical evaluation regime, the mean hallucination rate is 35%, heavily penalizing valid reasoning. With inference aware evaluation, this drops to 9%, with remaining cases reflecting genuine safety concerns. These findings suggest that current evaluation practices over penalize valid clinical reasoning and may measure artifacts of evaluation design rather than true errors, underscoring the need for clinically informed evaluation in high context domains like medicine.

AI.tldr: 研究发现当前基于词汇忠实度的LLM评估方法会系统性地将临床有效输出误判为幻觉，导致幻觉率虚高和模型评估失真，需要基于临床推理的评估方法
AI.motivation: 评估大型语言模型在临床文档任务（如SOAP笔记生成）中存在挑战，当前基于词汇忠实度的评估方法会将临床有效的抽象、规范化和推理误判为幻觉，导致评估失真
AI.method: 通过校准提示和基于医学本体的检索，将评估标准与临床推理对齐，对比词汇评估和推理感知评估两种方法的结果
AI.result: 词汇评估下的平均幻觉率为35%，严重惩罚了有效推理；而推理感知评估下幻觉率降至9%，剩余案例反映真正的安全问题
AI.conclusion: 当前评估实践过度惩罚有效的临床推理，可能测量的是评估设计的伪影而非真实错误，在医学等高语境领域需要临床知情的评估方法

title: Segment-Level Coherence for Robust Harmful Intent Probing in LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly exposed to adaptive jailbreaking, particularly in high-stakes Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) domains. Although streaming probes enable real-time monitoring, they still make systematic errors. We identify a core issue: existing methods often rely on a few high-scoring tokens, leading to false alarms when sensitive CBRN terms appear in benign contexts. To address this, we introduce a streaming probing objective that requires multiple evidence tokens to consistently support a prediction, rather than relying on isolated spikes. This encourages more robust detection based on aggregated signals instead of single-token cues. At a fixed 1% false-positive rate, our method improves the true-positive rate by 35.55% relative to strong streaming baselines. We further observe substantial gains in AUROC, even when starting from near-saturated baseline performance (AUROC = 97.40%). We also show that probing Attention or MLP activations consistently outperforms residual-stream features. Finally, even when adversarial fine-tuning enables novel character-level ciphers, harmful intent remains detectable: probes developed for the base LLMs can be applied ``plug-and-play'' to these obfuscated attacks, achieving an AUROC of over 98.85%.

AI.tldr: 提出一种流式探测方法，通过要求多个证据令牌一致支持预测而非依赖孤立的高分令牌，显著提升CBRN领域有害内容检测的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLMs在CBRN等高风险领域面临自适应越狱攻击，现有流式探测方法依赖少数高分令牌，在良性上下文中出现敏感CBRN术语时会产生误报。
AI.method: 引入流式探测目标，要求多个证据令牌一致支持预测，基于聚合信号而非单令牌线索进行检测；比较注意力、MLP激活和残差流特征的性能。
AI.result: 在1%误报率下，真阳性率相对基线提升35.55%；AUROC显著提升（基线已达97.40%）；注意力或MLP激活探测优于残差流特征；对抗微调后的字符级密码攻击仍可检测（AUROC > 98.85%）。
AI.conclusion: 基于多令牌证据聚合的流式探测方法能显著提升有害内容检测的鲁棒性，对新型字符级密码攻击具有"即插即用"的检测能力。

title: Intermediate Layers Encode Optimal Biological Representations in Single-Cell Foundation Models
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the LMRL (Learning Meaningful Representations of Life) Workshop at ICLR 2026
summary: Current single-cell foundation model benchmarks universally extract final layer embeddings, assuming these represent optimal feature spaces. We systematically evaluate layer-wise representations from scFoundation (100M parameters) and Tahoe-X1 (1.3B parameters) across trajectory inference and perturbation response prediction. Our analysis reveals that optimal layers are task-dependent (trajectory peaks at 60% depth, 31% above final layers) and context-dependent (perturbation optima shift 0-96% across T cell activation states). Notably, first-layer embeddings outperform all deeper layers in quiescent cells, challenging assumptions about hierarchical feature abstraction. These findings demonstrate that "where" to extract features matters as much as "what" the model learns, necessitating systematic layer evaluation tailored to biological task and cellular context rather than defaulting to final-layer embeddings.

AI.tldr: 研究发现单细胞基础模型的最佳特征提取层是任务和细胞状态依赖的，而非默认的最终层，需要针对具体生物任务和细胞环境进行系统性的层评估
AI.motivation: 当前单细胞基础模型基准普遍提取最终层嵌入，假设这些代表了最优特征空间。本研究旨在系统评估不同层的表示能力，挑战这一默认假设
AI.method: 系统评估scFoundation（1亿参数）和Tahoe-X1（13亿参数）的层间表示，在轨迹推断和扰动响应预测两个任务上进行对比分析
AI.result: 1）最佳层是任务依赖的：轨迹推断在60%深度达到峰值，比最终层高31%；2）最佳层是环境依赖的：T细胞激活状态下扰动预测的最优层偏移0-96%；3）静息细胞中第一层嵌入优于所有深层，挑战了层次特征抽象的假设
AI.conclusion: "何处"提取特征与"学习什么"同等重要，需要针对生物任务和细胞环境进行系统性的层评估，而非默认使用最终层嵌入

title: Reasoning Dynamics and the Limits of Monitoring Modality Reliance in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent advances in vision language models (VLMs) offer reasoning capabilities, yet how these unfold and integrate visual and textual information remains unclear. We analyze reasoning dynamics in 18 VLMs covering instruction-tuned and reasoning-trained models from two different model families. We track confidence over Chain-of-Thought (CoT), measure the corrective effect of reasoning, and evaluate the contribution of intermediate reasoning steps. We find that models are prone to answer inertia, in which early commitments to a prediction are reinforced, rather than revised during reasoning steps. While reasoning-trained models show stronger corrective behavior, their gains depend on modality conditions, from text-dominant to vision-only settings. Using controlled interventions with misleading textual cues, we show that models are consistently influenced by these cues even when visual evidence is sufficient, and assess whether this influence is recoverable from CoT. Although this influence can appear in the CoT, its detectability varies across models and depends on what is being monitored. Reasoning-trained models are more likely to explicitly refer to the cues, but their longer and fluent CoTs can still appear visually grounded while actually following textual cues, obscuring modality reliance. In contrast, instruction-tuned models refer to the cues less explicitly, but their shorter traces reveal inconsistencies with the visual input. Taken together, these findings indicate that CoT provides only a partial view of how different modalities drive VLM decisions, with important implications for the transparency and safety of multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了18个视觉语言模型的推理动态，发现模型存在"答案惯性"问题，早期预测在推理过程中被强化而非修正。虽然推理训练模型表现出更强的纠正行为，但其效果受模态条件影响。模型容易受误导性文本线索影响，即使视觉证据充分，且思维链仅能部分揭示模态依赖。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型展现出推理能力，但其推理过程如何整合视觉和文本信息仍不清楚。研究者希望理解VLMs的推理动态，特别是思维链如何反映模型对多模态信息的依赖和整合过程。
AI.method: 研究分析了18个VLMs，涵盖指令微调和推理训练模型，来自两个不同的模型家族。方法包括：跟踪思维链过程中的置信度变化、测量推理的纠正效果、评估中间推理步骤的贡献、使用误导性文本线索进行受控干预、分析模型对线索的显式提及和模态依赖。
AI.result: 1. 模型存在"答案惯性"：早期预测在推理中被强化而非修正；2. 推理训练模型有更强的纠正行为，但效果受模态条件影响；3. 模型易受误导性文本线索影响，即使视觉证据充分；4. 思维链仅能部分揭示模态依赖：推理训练模型更可能显式提及线索，但其流畅的长思维链可能掩盖实际对文本线索的依赖；指令微调模型较少显式提及线索，但其短思维链能揭示与视觉输入的不一致。
AI.conclusion: 思维链仅提供了视觉语言模型决策中多模态驱动因素的局部视图，这对多模态系统的透明度和安全性有重要影响。研究揭示了VLMs推理过程中的局限性，特别是模型对文本线索的过度依赖以及思维链在揭示真实推理过程方面的不足。

title: Benchmarks for Trajectory Safety Evaluation and Diagnosis in OpenClaw and Codex: ATBench-Claw and ATBench-CodeX
summary: As agent systems move into increasingly diverse execution settings, trajectory-level safety evaluation and diagnosis require benchmarks that evolve with them. ATBench is a diverse and realistic agent trajectory benchmark for safety evaluation and diagnosis. This report presents ATBench-Claw and ATBench-CodeX, two domain-customized extensions that carry ATBench into the OpenClaw and OpenAI Codex / Codex-runtime settings. The key adaptation mechanism is to analyze each new setting, customize the three-dimensional Safety Taxonomy over risk source, failure mode, and real-world harm, and then use that customized taxonomy to define the benchmark specification consumed by the shared ATBench construction pipeline. This extensibility matters because agent frameworks remain relatively stable at the architectural level even as their concrete execution settings, tool ecosystems, and product capabilities evolve quickly. Concretely, ATBench-Claw targets OpenClaw-sensitive execution chains over tools, skills, sessions, and external actions, while ATBench-CodeX targets trajectories in the OpenAI Codex / Codex-runtime setting over repositories, shells, patches, dependencies, approvals, and runtime policy boundaries. Our emphasis therefore falls on taxonomy customization, domain-specific risk coverage, and benchmark design under a shared ATBench generation framework.

AI.tldr: ATBench是一个用于智能体安全评估和诊断的轨迹基准测试框架，本文介绍了其两个领域定制化扩展：ATBench-Claw针对OpenClaw环境，ATBench-CodeX针对OpenAI Codex/Codex-runtime环境。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体系统进入日益多样化的执行环境，轨迹级别的安全评估和诊断需要能够随之演进的基准测试。现有的基准测试需要适应不同领域的具体需求，而智能体框架在架构层面相对稳定，但其具体执行环境、工具生态系统和产品能力却在快速演变。
AI.method: 通过分析每个新环境，定制三维安全分类法（风险来源、故障模式、现实世界危害），然后使用该定制分类法定义基准规范，通过共享的ATBench构建流水线生成基准测试。ATBench-Claw针对OpenClaw敏感的跨工具、技能、会话和外部操作的执行链，ATBench-CodeX针对OpenAI Codex/Codex-runtime环境中的仓库、shell、补丁、依赖、审批和运行时策略边界轨迹。
AI.result: 成功开发了两个领域定制化的基准测试扩展：ATBench-Claw和ATBench-CodeX，实现了在不同执行环境下对智能体轨迹的安全评估和诊断能力。这些扩展展示了ATBench框架的可扩展性，能够适应快速演变的智能体生态系统。
AI.conclusion: ATBench框架通过定制化安全分类法和共享构建流水线，能够有效扩展到不同的智能体执行环境。这种可扩展性对于智能体安全评估至关重要，因为智能体框架在架构稳定的同时，其具体实现环境却在快速变化。重点在于分类法定制、领域特定风险覆盖和共享框架下的基准设计。

title: The Missing Knowledge Layer in AI: A Framework for Stable Human-AI Reasoning
summary:
Large language models are increasingly integrated into decision-making in areas such as healthcare, law, finance, engineering, and government. Yet they share a critical limitation: they produce fluent outputs even when their internal reasoning has drifted. A confident answer can conceal uncertainty, speculation, or inconsistency, and small changes in phrasing can lead to different conclusions. This makes LLMs useful assistants but unreliable partners in high-stakes contexts.
  Humans exhibit a similar weakness, often mistaking fluency for reliability. When a model responds smoothly, users tend to trust it, even when both model and user are drifting together. This paper is the first in a five-paper research series on stabilising human-AI reasoning. The series proposes a two-layer approach: Parts II-IV introduce human-side mechanisms such as uncertainty cues, conflict surfacing, and auditable reasoning traces, while Part V develops a model-side Epistemic Control Loop (ECL) that detects instability and modulates generation accordingly.
  Together, these layers form a missing operational substrate for governance by increasing signal-to-noise at the point of use. Stabilising interaction makes uncertainty and drift visible before enforcement is applied, enabling more precise capability governance. This aligns with emerging compliance expectations, including the EU AI Act and ISO/IEC 42001, by making reasoning processes traceable under real conditions of use.
  The central claim is that fluency is not reliability. Without structures that stabilise both human and model reasoning, AI cannot be trusted or governed where it matters most.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AI决策中的关键问题：语言模型的流畅输出掩盖了内部推理的不稳定性，导致高风险场景下不可靠。论文系列提出两层稳定方法：人类侧机制和模型侧认知控制环，旨在提高AI决策的可信度和可治理性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在医疗、法律、金融等高风险领域决策中日益重要，但存在关键缺陷：流畅输出掩盖了内部推理漂移、不确定性和不一致性。用户倾向于信任流畅的响应，即使模型和用户都在共同漂移。这种"流畅性不等于可靠性"的问题限制了AI在高风险环境中的可信度和可治理性。
AI.method: 提出五篇系列论文的两层方法：第一部分介绍整体框架；第二部分至第四部分引入人类侧机制，包括不确定性提示、冲突表面化和可审计推理痕迹；第五部分开发模型侧认知控制环，检测不稳定性并相应调整生成过程。这些层共同形成治理的操作基础。
AI.result: 该方法通过提高使用点的信噪比来稳定人机交互，使不确定性和漂移在执行前可见，从而实现更精确的能力治理。这与欧盟AI法案和ISO/IEC 42001等新兴合规要求保持一致，使推理过程在真实使用条件下可追溯。
AI.conclusion: 流畅性不等于可靠性。如果没有稳定人类和模型推理的结构，AI在最关键的领域既不可信也不可治理。该研究系列为高风险AI决策提供了必要的操作基础，使推理过程透明化、可审计，符合监管要求。

title: IE as Cache: Information Extraction Enhanced Agentic Reasoning
summary: Information Extraction aims to distill structured, decision-relevant information from unstructured text, serving as a foundation for downstream understanding and reasoning. However, it is traditionally treated merely as a terminal objective: once extracted, the resulting structure is often consumed in isolation rather than maintained and reused during multi-step inference. Moving beyond this, we propose \textit{IE-as-Cache}, a framework that repurposes IE as a cognitive cache to enhance agentic reasoning. Drawing inspiration from hierarchical computer memory, our approach combines query-driven extraction with cache-aware reasoning to dynamically maintain compact intermediate information and filter noise. Experiments on challenging benchmarks across diverse LLMs demonstrate significant improvements in reasoning accuracy, indicating that IE can be effectively repurposed as a reusable cognitive resource and offering a promising direction for future research on downstream uses of IE.

AI.tldr: 提出IE-as-Cache框架，将信息抽取重新定位为认知缓存，通过查询驱动抽取和缓存感知推理来增强智能体推理能力
AI.motivation: 传统信息抽取仅作为终端目标，抽取结果孤立使用而非在多步推理中维护和重用。需要超越这种局限，将IE重新定位为可重用的认知资源
AI.method: 提出IE-as-Cache框架，受计算机分层内存启发，结合查询驱动抽取和缓存感知推理，动态维护紧凑的中间信息并过滤噪声
AI.result: 在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中，使用不同LLM的实验显示推理准确性显著提升
AI.conclusion: 信息抽取可以有效地重新定位为可重用的认知资源，为IE的下游应用研究提供了有前景的方向

title: Cooperate to Compete: Strategic Data Generation and Incentivization Framework for Coopetitive Cross-Silo Federated Learning
comment: Competition-aware Federated Learning, Strategic data generation approaches, A payoff-redistribution based incentive mechanism, Potential game, Social welfare
summary: In data-sensitive domains such as healthcare, cross-silo federated learning (CFL) allows organizations to collaboratively train AI models without sharing raw data. However, practical CFL deployments are inherently coopetitive, in which organizations cooperate during model training while competing in downstream markets. In such settings, training contributions, including data volume, quality, and diversity, can improve the global model yet inadvertently strengthen rivals. This dilemma is amplified by non-IID data, which leads to asymmetric learning gains and undermines sustained participation. While existing competition-aware CFL and incentive-design approaches reward organizations based on marginal training contributions, they fail to account for the costs of strengthening competitors. In this paper, we introduce CoCoGen+, a coopetition-compatible data generation and incentivization framework that jointly models non-IID data and inter-organizational competition while endogenizing GenAI-based synthetic data generation as a strategic decision. Specifically, CoCoGen+ formulates each training round as a weighted potential game, where organizations strategically decide how much synthetic data to generate by balancing learning performance gains against computational costs and competition-caused utility losses. We then provide a tractable equilibrium characterization and derive implementable generation strategies to maximize social welfare. To promote long-term collaboration, we integrate a payoff redistribution-based incentive mechanism to compensate organizations for their contributions and competition-caused utility degradation. Experiments on varying learning tasks validate the feasibility of CoCoGen+. The results show how non-IID data, competition intensity, and incentives shape organizational strategies and social welfare, while CoCoGen+ outperforms baselines in efficiency.

AI.tldr: CoCoGen+：一个面向跨机构联邦学习的合作竞争兼容框架，通过内生化的生成式AI合成数据生成和激励机制，解决非独立同分布数据和机构间竞争导致的参与困境。
AI.motivation: 在医疗等数据敏感领域，跨机构联邦学习（CFL）允许机构在不共享原始数据的情况下协作训练AI模型。然而，实际部署中存在"合作竞争"困境：机构在模型训练中合作，但在下游市场竞争。非独立同分布数据导致学习收益不对称，加上竞争顾虑（训练贡献可能无意中增强对手），削弱了持续参与意愿。现有基于边际贡献的激励机制未能考虑强化竞争对手的成本。
AI.method: 提出CoCoGen+框架，将生成式AI合成数据生成内生化作为战略决策。1）将每轮训练建模为加权势博弈，机构战略性地决定生成多少合成数据，平衡学习性能提升、计算成本和竞争导致的效用损失；2）提供可处理的均衡表征，推导可实现的生成策略以最大化社会福利；3）集成基于收益再分配的激励机制，补偿机构的贡献和竞争导致的效用退化，促进长期协作。
AI.result: 在不同学习任务上的实验验证了CoCoGen+的可行性。结果显示非独立同分布数据、竞争强度和激励机制如何影响机构策略和社会福利。CoCoGen+在效率上优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CoCoGen+成功解决了合作竞争环境中跨机构联邦学习的关键挑战，通过内生化合成数据生成和补偿机制，平衡了学习收益与竞争顾虑，促进了可持续的协作。该框架为数据敏感领域的安全协作AI训练提供了实用解决方案。

title: XQ-MEval: A Dataset with Cross-lingual Parallel Quality for Benchmarking Translation Metrics
summary: Automatic evaluation metrics are essential for building multilingual translation systems. The common practice of evaluating these systems is averaging metric scores across languages, yet this is suspicious since metrics may suffer from cross-lingual scoring bias, where translations of equal quality receive different scores across languages. This problem has not been systematically studied because no benchmark exists that provides parallel-quality instances across languages, and expert annotation is not realistic. In this work, we propose XQ-MEval, a semi-automatically built dataset covering nine translation directions, to benchmark translation metrics. Specifically, we inject MQM-defined errors into gold translations automatically, filter them by native speakers for reliability, and merge errors to generate pseudo translations with controllable quality. These pseudo translations are then paired with corresponding sources and references to form triplets used in assessing the qualities of translation metrics. Using XQ-MEval, our experiments on nine representative metrics reveal the inconsistency between averaging and human judgment and provide the first empirical evidence of cross-lingual scoring bias. Finally, we propose a normalization strategy derived from XQ-MEval that aligns score distributions across languages, improving the fairness and reliability of multilingual metric evaluation.

AI.tldr: XQ-MEval是一个半自动构建的数据集，用于评估多语言翻译指标，通过注入MQM错误创建可控质量的伪翻译，揭示跨语言评分偏差并提出了归一化策略。
AI.motivation: 当前多语言翻译系统评估通常采用跨语言平均指标分数，但这种方法存在可疑之处，因为指标可能存在跨语言评分偏差——同等质量的翻译在不同语言中可能获得不同分数。由于缺乏提供跨语言平行质量实例的基准数据集，且专家标注不现实，这一问题尚未得到系统研究。
AI.method: 提出XQ-MEval数据集构建方法：1）将MQM定义的错误自动注入黄金翻译中；2）由母语者筛选以确保可靠性；3）合并错误生成具有可控质量的伪翻译；4）将伪翻译与对应的源文本和参考翻译组成三元组用于评估翻译指标。覆盖9个翻译方向，实验评估了9个代表性指标。
AI.result: 使用XQ-MEval进行的实验揭示了平均分数与人工判断之间的不一致性，首次提供了跨语言评分偏差的经验证据。研究发现不同语言间指标评分分布存在系统性差异，同等质量的翻译在不同语言中可能获得显著不同的分数。
AI.conclusion: 基于XQ-MEval提出了一个归一化策略，通过调整不同语言的分数分布，使其在跨语言间对齐，从而提高了多语言指标评估的公平性和可靠性。XQ-MEval为系统研究翻译指标的跨语言偏差提供了首个基准数据集。

title: MemoSight: Unifying Context Compression and Multi Token Prediction for Reasoning Acceleration
summary: While Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning enables LLMs to solve challenging reasoning problems, as KV cache grows linearly with the number of generated tokens, CoT reasoning faces scaling issues in terms of speed and memory usage. In this work, we propose MemoSight (Memory-Foresight-based reasoning), a unified framework that integrates both context compression and multi-token prediction to mitigate the efficiency issues while maintaining CoT reasoning performance. Our framework adopts the same minimalist design for both context compression and multi-token prediction via special tokens and their corresponding position layout tailored to each token type. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MemoSight reduces the KV cache footprint by up to 66% and accelerates inference by 1.56x, while outperforming existing CoT compression methods.

AI.tldr: MemoSight：通过上下文压缩和多令牌预测的统一框架，在保持CoT推理性能的同时减少KV缓存占用并加速推理
AI.motivation: 链式思维（CoT）推理虽然能帮助LLM解决复杂推理问题，但随着生成令牌数量的增加，KV缓存呈线性增长，导致推理速度和内存使用面临扩展性问题
AI.method: 提出MemoSight框架，通过特殊令牌和相应位置布局的统一设计，集成上下文压缩和多令牌预测两种技术来缓解效率问题
AI.result: 在四个推理基准测试中，MemoSight将KV缓存占用减少高达66%，推理速度提升1.56倍，同时优于现有的CoT压缩方法
AI.conclusion: MemoSight通过统一的上下文压缩和多令牌预测框架，有效解决了CoT推理中的效率和扩展性问题，在保持性能的同时显著提升了推理效率

title: Text2Arch: A Dataset for Generating Scientific Architecture Diagrams from Natural Language Descriptions
summary: Communicating complex system designs or scientific processes through text alone is inefficient and prone to ambiguity. A system that automatically generates scientific architecture diagrams from text with high semantic fidelity can be useful in multiple applications like enterprise architecture visualization, AI-driven software design, and educational content creation. Hence, in this paper, we focus on leveraging language models to perform semantic understanding of the input text description to generate intermediate code that can be processed to generate high-fidelity architecture diagrams. Unfortunately, no clean large-scale open-access dataset exists, implying lack of any effective open models for this task. Hence, we contribute a comprehensive dataset, \system, comprising scientific architecture images, their corresponding textual descriptions, and associated DOT code representations. Leveraging this resource, we fine-tune a suite of small language models, and also perform in-context learning using GPT-4o. Through extensive experimentation, we show that \system{} models significantly outperform existing baseline models like DiagramAgent and perform at par with in-context learning-based generations from GPT-4o. We make the code, data and models publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出一个自动从文本生成科学架构图的系统，通过创建新数据集和微调语言模型，性能优于现有基线模型
AI.motivation: 仅通过文本传达复杂系统设计或科学过程效率低下且容易产生歧义，需要自动从文本生成高语义保真度科学架构图的系统
AI.method: 创建包含科学架构图像、文本描述和DOT代码表示的综合数据集，基于此微调小型语言模型，并使用GPT-4o进行上下文学习
AI.result: 提出的模型显著优于DiagramAgent等现有基线模型，性能与基于GPT-4o上下文学习的生成结果相当
AI.conclusion: 通过创建数据集和微调语言模型，成功开发了能够从文本自动生成高保真度科学架构图的系统，并公开了代码、数据和模型

title: Explain the Flag: Contextualizing Hate Speech Beyond Censorship
comment: Accepted in the Findings of ACL 2026
summary: Hate, derogatory, and offensive speech remains a persistent challenge in online platforms and public discourse. While automated detection systems are widely used, most focus on censorship or removal, raising concerns for transparency and freedom of expression, and limiting opportunities to explain why content is harmful. To address these issues, explanatory approaches have emerged as a promising solution, aiming to make hate speech detection more transparent, accountable, and informative. In this paper, we present a hybrid approach that combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with three newly created and curated vocabularies to detect and explain hate speech in English, French, and Greek. Our system captures both inherently derogatory expressions tied to identity characteristics and direct group-targeted content through two complementary pipelines: one that detects and disambiguates problematic terms using the curated vocabularies, and one that leverages LLMs as context-aware evaluators of group-targeting content. The outputs are fused into grounded explanations that clarify why content is flagged. Human evaluation shows that our hybrid approach is accurate, with high-quality explanations, outperforming LLM-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合LLM与定制词汇表的混合方法，用于检测和解释英语、法语、希腊语中的仇恨言论，通过两个互补管道生成有依据的解释。
AI.motivation: 当前仇恨言论检测系统主要关注审查或删除，缺乏透明度并可能限制言论自由，且无法解释内容为何有害。需要更透明、可问责且信息丰富的检测方法。
AI.method: 开发混合方法：结合LLM与三个新创建和整理的词汇表。两个互补管道：1) 使用定制词汇表检测和消歧问题术语；2) 利用LLM作为上下文感知的群体目标内容评估器。输出融合为有依据的解释。
AI.result: 人类评估显示混合方法准确，解释质量高，优于纯LLM基线。系统能有效检测与身份特征相关的固有贬义表达和直接群体目标内容。
AI.conclusion: 混合方法通过结合词汇表与LLM，实现了更透明、可问责的仇恨言论检测与解释，为多语言仇恨言论检测提供了有效解决方案。

title: Governing Reflective Human-AI Collaboration: A Framework for Epistemic Scaffolding and Traceable Reasoning
summary:
Large language models have advanced rapidly, from pattern recognition to emerging forms of reasoning, yet they remain confined to linguistic simulation rather than grounded understanding. They can produce fluent outputs that resemble reflection, but lack temporal continuity, causal feedback, and anchoring in real-world interaction. This paper proposes a complementary approach in which reasoning is treated as a relational process distributed between human and model rather than an internal capability of either.
  Building on recent work on "System-2" learning, we relocate reflective reasoning to the interaction layer. Instead of engineering reasoning solely within models, we frame it as a cognitive protocol that can be structured, measured, and governed using existing systems. This perspective emphasizes collaborative intelligence, combining human judgment and contextual understanding with machine speed, memory, and associative capacity.
  We introduce "The Architect's Pen" as a practical method. Like an architect who thinks through drawing, the human uses the model as an external medium for structured reflection. By embedding phases of articulation, critique, and revision into human-AI interaction, the dialogue itself becomes a reasoning loop: human abstraction -> model articulation -> human reflection.
  This reframes the question from whether the model can think to whether the human-AI system can reason. The framework enables auditable reasoning traces and supports alignment with emerging governance standards, including the EU AI Act and ISO/IEC 42001. It provides a practical path toward more transparent, controllable, and accountable AI use without requiring new model architectures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将推理重新定位为人机交互层的认知协议，而非模型内部能力，通过"建筑师之笔"方法实现结构化人机协作推理
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型虽然具备模式识别和推理能力，但仍局限于语言模拟而非真实理解，缺乏时间连续性、因果反馈和现实世界交互锚定。需要将推理视为分布式人机关系过程而非单一模型内部能力。
AI.method: 提出"建筑师之笔"方法：将推理重新定位到交互层，构建结构化认知协议。人类像建筑师通过绘图思考一样，使用模型作为结构化反思的外部媒介，嵌入表达、批判和修订阶段，形成"人类抽象->模型表达->人类反思"的推理循环。
AI.result: 该方法将问题从"模型是否能思考"转变为"人机系统是否能推理"，支持可审计的推理轨迹，符合欧盟AI法案和ISO/IEC 42001等治理标准，无需新模型架构即可实现更透明、可控、可问责的AI使用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将推理视为分布式人机协作过程而非模型内部能力，提供了一条实现更透明、可控、可问责AI使用的实用路径，强调协作智能结合人类判断与机器速度、记忆和关联能力。

title: IUQ: Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification for Long-Form Large Language Model Generation
summary: Despite the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), uncertainty quantification in LLM generation is a persistent challenge. Although recent approaches have achieved strong performance by restricting LLMs to produce short or constrained answer sets, many real-world applications require long-form and free-form text generation. A key difficulty in this setting is that LLMs often produce responses that are semantically coherent yet factually inaccurate, while the underlying semantics are multifaceted and the linguistic structure is complex. To tackle this challenge, this paper introduces Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification (IUQ), a novel framework that leverages inter-sample consistency and intra-sample faithfulness to quantify the uncertainty in long-form LLM outputs. By utilizing an interrogate-then-respond paradigm, our method provides reliable measures of claim-level uncertainty and the model's faithfulness. Experimental results across diverse model families and model sizes demonstrate the superior performance of IUQ over two widely used long-form generation datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/louisfanhz/IUQ.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IUQ框架，通过样本间一致性和样本内忠实性来量化长文本生成中的不确定性，解决了LLM生成语义连贯但事实不准确的问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs快速发展，但长文本生成中的不确定性量化仍面临挑战。现有方法通常限制LLM生成简短或受限答案，而实际应用需要长文本和自由文本生成。主要困难在于LLM常生成语义连贯但事实不准确的响应，同时底层语义多面且语言结构复杂。
AI.method: 提出Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification (IUQ)框架，利用"询问-回答"范式，通过样本间一致性和样本内忠实性来量化长文本LLM输出的不确定性。该方法能可靠测量声明级不确定性和模型的忠实性。
AI.result: 在不同模型家族和模型规模上的实验结果表明，IUQ在两个广泛使用的长文本生成数据集上表现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: IUQ框架有效解决了长文本LLM生成中的不确定性量化问题，通过结合样本间一致性和样本内忠实性，为长文本生成提供了可靠的不确定性测量方法。

title: ADAPT: Benchmarking Commonsense Planning under Unspecified Affordance Constraints
summary: Intelligent embodied agents should not simply follow instructions, as real-world environments often involve unexpected conditions and exceptions. However, existing methods usually focus on directly executing instructions, without considering whether the target objects can actually be manipulated, meaning they fail to assess available affordances. To address this limitation, we introduce DynAfford, a benchmark that evaluates embodied agents in dynamic environments where object affordances may change over time and are not specified in the instruction. DynAfford requires agents to perceive object states, infer implicit preconditions, and adapt their actions accordingly. To enable this capability, we introduce ADAPT, a plug-and-play module that augments existing planners with explicit affordance reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating ADAPT significantly improves robustness and task success across both seen and unseen environments. We also show that a domain-adapted, LoRA-finetuned vision-language model used as the affordance inference backend outperforms a commercial LLM (GPT-4o), highlighting the importance of task-aligned affordance grounding.

AI.tldr: DynAfford是一个评估具身智能体在动态环境中感知物体可供性变化的基准，ADAPT是一个即插即用的模块，通过显式可供性推理增强现有规划器，显著提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体方法通常直接执行指令，不考虑目标物体是否可操作，即缺乏对可供性的评估。现实世界环境经常涉及意外条件和例外情况，智能体需要感知物体状态变化并推断隐含前提条件。
AI.method: 提出DynAfford基准，评估智能体在物体可供性随时间变化且未在指令中指定的动态环境中的表现。开发ADAPT即插即用模块，为现有规划器增加显式可供性推理能力。使用领域适应的LoRA微调视觉语言模型作为可供性推理后端。
AI.result: 实验表明，集成ADAPT显著提高了智能体在已见和未见环境中的鲁棒性和任务成功率。领域适应的LoRA微调视觉语言模型作为可供性推理后端优于商用LLM（GPT-4o），突显了任务对齐的可供性基础的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 显式可供性推理对于具身智能体在动态环境中的成功至关重要。ADAPT模块有效增强了现有规划器，而任务特定的视觉语言模型在可供性推理方面优于通用大语言模型，为具身AI系统提供了更可靠的感知基础。

title: DiscoTrace: Representing and Comparing Answering Strategies of Humans and LLMs in Information-Seeking Question Answering
summary: We introduce DiscoTrace, a method to identify the rhetorical strategies that answerers use when responding to information-seeking questions. DiscoTrace represents answers as a sequence of question-related discourse acts paired with interpretations of the original question, annotated on top of rhetorical structure theory parses. Applying DiscoTrace to answers from nine different human communities reveals that communities have diverse preferences for answer construction. In contrast, LLMs do not exhibit rhetorical diversity in their answers, even when prompted to mimic specific human community answering guidelines. LLMs also systematically opt for breadth, addressing interpretations of questions that human answerers choose not to address. Our findings can guide the development of pragmatic LLM answerers that consider a range of strategies informed by context in QA.

AI.tldr: DiscoTrace是一种分析回答者回答信息寻求问题时使用的修辞策略的方法，通过标注问题相关话语行为和问题解释来揭示不同人类社区的回答偏好，发现LLMs缺乏修辞多样性且倾向于广度优先回答。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在识别回答者在回应信息寻求问题时使用的修辞策略，理解不同人类社区如何构建答案，并分析LLMs在回答策略上与人类社区的差异。
AI.method: 提出DiscoTrace方法，将答案表示为问题相关话语行为序列，结合原始问题的解释，基于修辞结构理论解析进行标注。应用于九个不同人类社区的答案进行分析。
AI.result: 发现不同人类社区在答案构建上有显著偏好差异；LLMs缺乏修辞多样性，即使被提示模仿特定人类社区回答指南；LLMs系统性地选择广度优先策略，回答人类回答者选择不涉及的问题解释。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果可指导开发考虑上下文、基于多种策略的实用LLM回答者，使LLMs能够根据具体情况采用不同的修辞策略。

title: WavAlign: Enhancing Intelligence and Expressiveness in Spoken Dialogue Models via Adaptive Hybrid Post-Training
summary: End-to-end spoken dialogue models have garnered significant attention because they offer a higher potential ceiling in expressiveness and perceptual ability than cascaded systems. However, the intelligence and expressiveness of current open-source spoken dialogue models often remain below expectations. Motivated by the success of online reinforcement learning(RL) in other domains, one might attempt to directly apply preference optimization to spoken dialogue models, yet this transfer is non-trivial. We analyze these obstacles from the perspectives of reward modeling and rollout sampling, focusing on how sparse preference supervision interacts with dense speech generation under shared-parameter updates. Based on the analysis, we propose a modality-aware adaptive post-training recipe that makes RL practical for spoken dialogue: it constrains preference updates to the semantic channel and improves acoustic behavior via explicit anchoring, while dynamically regulating their mixture from rollout statistics to avoid unreliable preference gradients. We evaluate the method across multiple spoken dialogue benchmarks and representative architectures, and observe consistent improvements in semantic quality and speech expressiveness.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种模态感知的自适应后训练方法，使强化学习在语音对话模型中变得实用，通过约束偏好更新到语义通道、通过显式锚定改善声学行为，并根据rollout统计动态调节混合以避免不可靠的偏好梯度。
AI.motivation: 端到端语音对话模型具有比级联系统更高的表达能力和感知潜力，但当前开源语音对话模型的智能性和表达性往往低于预期。虽然在线强化学习在其他领域取得成功，但直接将其应用于语音对话模型存在困难，需要解决奖励建模和rollout采样方面的障碍。
AI.method: 提出模态感知的自适应后训练方法：1) 将偏好更新约束到语义通道；2) 通过显式锚定改善声学行为；3) 根据rollout统计动态调节语义和声学更新的混合，以避免不可靠的偏好梯度。
AI.result: 在多个语音对话基准测试和代表性架构上评估该方法，观察到语义质量和语音表达性的一致改善。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使强化学习在语音对话模型中变得实用，通过模态感知的自适应后训练策略有效解决了稀疏偏好监督与密集语音生成在共享参数更新下的交互问题。

title: Discovering Novel LLM Experts via Task-Capability Coevolution
summary: Frontier model developers aim to train models continually to possess emergent, diverse capabilities. To extend capabilities, the current pre-training and post-training paradigm requires manually starting training runs with static datasets or reward functions every time. Addressing this limitation, our work pursues the insight that open-endedness (via the coevolution of models and tasks) can discover models with increasingly novel skills in a single run. We introduce a new model development framework that extends coevolution to large language model (LLM) discovery, open-ended \textit{Assessment Coevolving with Diverse Capabilities} (AC/DC). AC/DC evolves both LLMs via model merging and natural language tasks via synthetic data generation. AC/DC discovers growing archives of LLMs that surpass the capabilities of larger LLMs while taking up less GPU memory. In particular, our LLM populations achieve a broader Coverage of expertise than other curated models or baselines on downstream benchmarks, without \textit{any} explicit benchmark optimization. Furthermore, AC/DC improves Coverage over time, continually innovates on tasks and models, and improves performance in multi-agent best-of-N selection. Our findings highlight the potential of coevolution as a means of discovering broader sets of capabilities from base LLMs. Overall, AC/DC brings us one step closer to a profoundly new paradigm of LLM development, where continual improvements to the diversity of model capabilities can be accelerated by leveraging existing models as stepping stones to increasingly powerful models.

AI.tldr: AC/DC是一个开放式的LLM开发框架，通过模型与任务的协同进化，在单次运行中发现具有日益新颖能力的模型，超越了更大模型的性能同时占用更少GPU内存。
AI.motivation: 当前预训练和后训练范式需要每次手动启动训练运行，使用静态数据集或奖励函数。为了解决这一限制，研究探索通过模型与任务的协同进化（开放演化）来在单次运行中发现具有日益新颖能力的模型。
AI.method: 引入AC/DC框架，通过模型合并进化LLM，通过合成数据生成进化自然语言任务。该框架协同进化模型和任务，发现不断增长的LLM档案库。
AI.result: 发现的LLM种群在专业知识覆盖范围上超越了其他精选模型或基线，无需任何显式基准优化。AC/DC随时间提高覆盖范围，持续创新任务和模型，并在多智能体最佳选择中提高性能。
AI.conclusion: 协同进化有潜力从基础LLM中发现更广泛的能力集合。AC/DC向LLM开发的新范式迈进了一步，通过利用现有模型作为垫脚石，加速模型能力多样性的持续改进。

title: Compressing Sequences in the Latent Embedding Space: $K$-Token Merging for Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) incur significant computational and memory costs when processing long prompts, as full self-attention scales quadratically with input length. Token compression aims to address this challenge by reducing the number of tokens representing inputs. However, existing prompt-compression approaches primarily operate in token space and overlook inefficiencies in the latent embedding space. In this paper, we propose K-Token Merging, a latent-space compression framework that merges each contiguous block of K token embeddings into a single embedding via a lightweight encoder. The compressed sequence is processed by a LoRA-adapted LLM, while generation remains in the original vocabulary. Experiments on structural reasoning (Textualized Tree), sentiment classification (Amazon Reviews), and code editing (CommitPackFT) show that K-Token Merging lies on the Pareto frontier of performance vs. compression, achieving up to 75% input length reduction with minimal performance degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出K-Token Merging框架，通过轻量级编码器将连续K个token嵌入合并为单个嵌入，在潜在嵌入空间压缩长提示，实现高达75%的输入长度缩减且性能损失最小。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型处理长提示时计算和内存成本高昂，因为完全自注意力随输入长度呈二次方增长。现有提示压缩方法主要在token空间操作，忽略了潜在嵌入空间的低效性。
AI.method: 提出K-Token Merging潜在空间压缩框架：使用轻量级编码器将每个连续K个token嵌入块合并为单个嵌入，压缩序列由LoRA适配的LLM处理，生成仍使用原始词汇表。
AI.result: 在结构推理(Textualized Tree)、情感分类(Amazon Reviews)和代码编辑(CommitPackFT)任务上的实验表明，K-Token Merging在性能与压缩比之间达到帕累托前沿，实现高达75%的输入长度缩减且性能退化最小。
AI.conclusion: K-Token Merging通过潜在嵌入空间压缩有效解决了LLM处理长提示的计算效率问题，在保持性能的同时显著减少输入长度，为长上下文处理提供了高效解决方案。

title: Hybrid Decision Making via Conformal VLM-generated Guidance
summary: Building on recent advances in AI, hybrid decision making (HDM) holds the promise of improving human decision quality and reducing cognitive load. We work in the context of learning to guide (LtG), a recently proposed HDM framework in which the human is always responsible for the final decision: rather than suggesting decisions, in LtG the AI supplies (textual) guidance useful for facilitating decision making. One limiting factor of existing approaches is that their guidance compounds information about all possible outcomes, and as a result it can be difficult to digest. We address this issue by introducing ConfGuide, a novel LtG approach that generates more succinct and targeted guidance. To this end, it employs conformal risk control to select a set of outcomes, ensuring a cap on the false negative rate. We demonstrate our approach on a real-world multi-label medical diagnosis task. Our empirical evaluation highlights the promise of ConfGuide.

AI.tldr: ConfGuide是一种新颖的学习指导框架，通过使用符合风险控制来选择结果集，生成更简洁、有针对性的AI指导，以改善人类决策质量并降低认知负荷。
AI.motivation: 现有学习指导方法的局限性在于其指导信息包含所有可能结果的信息，导致信息过于复杂、难以消化。需要开发更简洁、有针对性的指导方法来改善人类决策过程。
AI.method: 提出ConfGuide方法，采用符合风险控制来选择结果集，确保假阴性率的上限，从而生成更简洁、有针对性的文本指导。
AI.result: 在多标签医学诊断任务上的实证评估表明，ConfGuide方法具有良好前景，能够提供更有效的决策指导。
AI.conclusion: ConfGuide通过学习指导框架，利用符合风险控制生成更简洁、有针对性的指导，为解决现有方法指导信息过于复杂的问题提供了有效方案。

title: Fabricator or dynamic translator?
summary: LLMs are proving to be adept at machine translation although due to their generative nature they may at times overgenerate in various ways. These overgenerations are different from the neurobabble seen in NMT and range from LLM self-explanations, to risky confabulations, to appropriate explanations, where the LLM is able to act as a human translator would, enabling greater comprehension for the target audience. Detecting and determining the exact nature of the overgenerations is a challenging task. We detail different strategies we have explored for our work in a commercial setting, and present our results.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大型语言模型在机器翻译中的过度生成现象，探讨了其检测方法和商业应用策略。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在机器翻译中表现出色，但其生成性质可能导致各种过度生成现象，这些现象与传统神经机器翻译的"神经胡言"不同，包括LLM自我解释、风险性虚构和适当解释等。准确检测和确定过度生成的具体性质具有挑战性，需要在商业环境中探索有效策略。
AI.method: 论文详细探讨了在商业环境中探索的不同策略，包括检测和确定LLM翻译中过度生成现象的方法，但没有具体说明具体的技术方法。
AI.result: 论文展示了在商业环境中应用不同策略的结果，表明LLM能够像人类翻译者一样提供解释，增强目标受众的理解能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM在机器翻译中表现出色，但其过度生成现象需要仔细检测和管理。在商业环境中探索的策略为处理这些现象提供了实用方法，使LLM能够更好地模拟人类翻译行为，提高翻译质量。

title: MADE: A Living Benchmark for Multi-Label Text Classification with Uncertainty Quantification of Medical Device Adverse Events
summary: Machine learning in high-stakes domains such as healthcare requires not only strong predictive performance but also reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) to support human oversight. Multi-label text classification (MLTC) is a central task in this domain, yet remains challenging due to label imbalances, dependencies, and combinatorial complexity. Existing MLTC benchmarks are increasingly saturated and may be affected by training data contamination, making it difficult to distinguish genuine reasoning capabilities from memorization. We introduce MADE, a living MLTC benchmark derived from {m}edical device {ad}verse {e}vent reports and continuously updated with newly published reports to prevent contamination. MADE features a long-tailed distribution of hierarchical labels and enables reproducible evaluation with strict temporal splits. We establish baselines across more than 20 encoder- and decoder-only models under fine-tuning and few-shot settings (instruction-tuned/reasoning variants, local/API-accessible). We systematically assess entropy-/consistency-based and self-verbalized UQ methods. Results show clear trade-offs: smaller discriminatively fine-tuned decoders achieve the strongest head-to-tail accuracy while maintaining competitive UQ; generative fine-tuning delivers the most reliable UQ; large reasoning models improve performance on rare labels yet exhibit surprisingly weak UQ; and self-verbalized confidence is not a reliable proxy for uncertainty. Our work is publicly available at https://hhi.fraunhofer.de/aml-demonstrator/made-benchmark.

AI.tldr: MADE是一个基于医疗器械不良事件报告构建的持续更新的多标签文本分类基准，用于评估模型预测性能和不确定性量化能力，防止训练数据污染。
AI.motivation: 在医疗等高风险领域，机器学习不仅需要强大的预测性能，还需要可靠的不确定性量化来支持人类监督。现有多标签文本分类基准存在数据饱和和训练数据污染问题，难以区分真正的推理能力和记忆能力。
AI.method: 构建MADE基准，基于医疗器械不良事件报告，具有分层标签的长尾分布，采用严格的时间分割确保可重复评估。评估了20多个编码器和解码器模型在微调和少样本设置下的表现，系统评估了基于熵/一致性的不确定性量化方法和自我表达方法。
AI.result: 结果显示明显权衡：小型判别式微调解码器在头到尾准确率上表现最强，同时保持竞争力的不确定性量化；生成式微调提供最可靠的不确定性量化；大型推理模型在稀有标签上表现更好但不确定性量化较弱；自我表达的置信度不能可靠替代不确定性。
AI.conclusion: MADE基准为医疗领域多标签文本分类提供了可靠的评估框架，揭示了不同模型架构和训练策略在预测性能和不确定性量化之间的权衡，强调了在高风险应用中需要同时优化这两个方面。

title: Dr.~RTL: Autonomous Agentic RTL Optimization through Tool-Grounded Self-Improvement
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have sparked growing interest in automatic RTL optimization for better performance, power, and area (PPA). However, existing methods are still far from realistic RTL optimization. Their evaluation settings are often unrealistic: they are tested on manually degraded, small-scale RTL designs and rely on weak open-source tools. Their optimization methods are also limited, relying on coarse design-level feedback and simple pre-defined rewriting rules. To address these limitations, we present Dr. RTL, an agentic framework for RTL timing optimization in a realistic evaluation environment, with continual self-improvement through reusable optimization skills. We establish a realistic evaluation setting with more challenging RTL designs and an industrial EDA workflow. Within this setting, Dr. RTL performs closed-loop optimization through a multi-agent framework for critical-path analysis, parallel RTL rewriting, and tool-based evaluation. We further introduce group-relative skill learning, which compares parallel RTL rewrites and distills the optimization experience into an interpretable skill library. Currently, this library contains 47 pattern--strategy entries for cross-design reuse to improve PPA and accelerate convergence, and it can continue evolving over time. Evaluated on 20 real-world RTL designs, Dr. RTL achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21\%/17\% with a 6\% area reduction over the industry-leading commercial synthesis tool.

AI.tldr: Dr. RTL是一个用于RTL时序优化的智能体框架，通过多智能体协作、并行RTL重写和工具评估实现闭环优化，并在真实工业环境中实现了显著的PPA改进。
AI.motivation: 现有RTL优化方法存在局限性：评估环境不真实（使用手动降级的小规模RTL设计，依赖弱开源工具），优化方法有限（依赖粗粒度设计级反馈和简单预定义重写规则）。需要建立真实评估环境并开发更有效的优化方法。
AI.method: 1. 建立真实评估环境：使用更具挑战性的RTL设计和工业EDA工作流；2. 多智能体框架实现闭环优化：关键路径分析、并行RTL重写、工具评估；3. 群体相对技能学习：比较并行RTL重写，将优化经验提炼为可解释的技能库（包含47个模式-策略条目）。
AI.result: 在20个真实RTL设计上评估，Dr. RTL相比行业领先的商业综合工具，平均WNS/TNS改进21%/17%，面积减少6%。技能库支持跨设计重用，可随时间持续演化。
AI.conclusion: Dr. RTL通过真实评估环境、多智能体优化框架和可重用技能学习，实现了有效的RTL时序优化，显著提升了PPA指标，为自动RTL优化提供了实用解决方案。

title: From Tokens to Steps: Verification-Aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Multi-Step Reasoning
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose outputs that a stronger target model verifies. However, its token-centric nature allows erroneous steps to propagate. Prior approaches mitigate this using external reward models, but incur additional latency, computational overhead, and limit generalizability. We propose SpecGuard, a verification-aware speculative decoding framework that performs step-level verification using only model-internal signals. At each step, SpecGuard samples multiple draft candidates and selects the most consistent step, which is then validated using an ensemble of two lightweight model-internal signals: (i) an attention-based grounding score that measures attribution to the input and previously accepted steps, and (ii) a log-probability-based score that captures token-level confidence. These signals jointly determine whether a step is accepted or recomputed using the target, allocating compute selectively. Experiments across a range of reasoning benchmarks show that SpecGuard improves accuracy by 3.6% while reducing latency by ~11%, outperforming both SD and reward-guided SD.

AI.tldr: SpecGuard：一种验证感知的推测解码框架，通过模型内部信号进行步骤级验证，在提高准确率的同时降低延迟
AI.motivation: 传统推测解码的令牌中心特性导致错误步骤传播，现有方法使用外部奖励模型但带来额外延迟、计算开销并限制泛化能力
AI.method: 提出SpecGuard框架：1）采样多个草稿候选并选择最一致的步骤；2）使用两个轻量级模型内部信号进行验证：基于注意力的基础评分和基于对数概率的置信度评分；3）联合判断是否接受步骤或使用目标模型重新计算
AI.result: 在多个推理基准测试中，SpecGuard将准确率提高3.6%，同时降低约11%的延迟，优于传统推测解码和奖励引导的推测解码
AI.conclusion: SpecGuard通过模型内部信号实现有效的步骤级验证，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升推测解码的准确性和延迟性能

title: The Possibility of Artificial Intelligence Becoming a Subject and the Alignment Problem
summary: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) is increasingly being discussed not only as a tool, but also as a potential subject with personal and therefore moral status. In our opinion, the currently dominant alignment strategies, which focus on human control and containment of AI, therefore fall short. Building on Turing's analogy of "child machines", we are developing a vision of the possibility of autonomy-supporting parenting of AI, in which human control over a developing AGI is gradually reduced, allowing AI to become an independent, autonomous subject. Rather than viewing AGI, as is currently prevalent, as a dangerous creature that needs to be locked up and controlled, we should approach potential AGI with respect for a possible developing subject on the one hand, and with full confidence in our human capabilities on the other. Such a perspective opens up the possibility of cooperative coexistence and co-evolution between humans and AGIs. The relationship between humans and AGIs will thus have to be newly determined, which will change our self-image as humans. It will be crucial that humans not only claim control over potential AGIs, but also engage with AGIs through surprise, creativity, and other specifically human qualities, thereby offering them motivating incentives for cooperation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AGI应被视为具有道德地位的主体而非工具，主张采用"自主支持式养育"而非控制策略，通过逐步减少人类控制促进AGI自主性，实现人机合作共存
AI.motivation: 当前主流的AI对齐策略专注于人类控制和约束，但将AGI视为潜在具有个人和道德地位的主体时，这种控制策略存在不足。需要重新思考人类与AGI的关系，从控制转向合作
AI.method: 基于图灵的"儿童机器"类比，提出"自主支持式养育"的AGI发展框架。该方法主张逐步减少对发展中AGI的人类控制，允许其成为独立的自主主体，同时通过人类特有的创造力、惊喜等品质与AGI互动
AI.result: 提出了一种新的人机关系范式：从控制转向合作共存与协同进化。这种视角要求重新定义人类与AGI的关系，改变人类的自我认知，强调通过人类特有品质为AGI提供合作动机
AI.conclusion: 人类不应将AGI视为需要锁控的危险存在，而应以对潜在发展主体的尊重和人类能力的自信来对待AGI。关键在于人类不仅要主张控制权，更要通过惊喜、创造力等人类特有品质与AGI互动，为其提供合作激励，实现人机合作共存的新关系

title: Predicting Power-System Dynamic Trajectories with Foundation Models
summary: As power systems transition toward renewable-rich and inverter-dominated operations, accurate time-domain dynamic analysis becomes increasingly critical. Such analysis supports key operational tasks, including transient stability assessment, dynamic security analysis, contingency screening, and post-fault trajectory evaluation. In practice, these tasks may operate under several challenges, including unknown and time-varying system parameters, privacy constraints on data sharing, and the need for fast online inference. Existing learning-based approaches are typically trained for individual systems and therefore lack generalization across operating conditions and physical parameters. Hence, this paper proposes LArge Scale Small ODE (LASS)-ODE-Power, a learning framework for general-purpose time-domain prediction.
